subject: Why chemistry?
body:
What is true about the world?

| | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=a64cba9d0ca14a46907ae285b13ffdcf&_t=kpAYdcq5AIqZh9HV22r19sKcEpdez-rAwD9fkU6iDkVUPHkxlAEawBGUFqnGWJJ1UVTUMidkDOiRHK53NeMECIn3TvNsns_ZETR-nqv8t5cVFKuZT91Z1aLpIgvLtiuJ)_

| | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a64cba9d0ca14a46907ae285b13ffdcf&_e=iSyR-7YQuDYywyDTQrxZMjk7RewT73zyC95PwdPrQrTXzEj4gtiFumtdhI5lgVSuh0jBmB99RpUu_lSb9XV0bIwf512LZT8452WSZfY4wNg9amJZfgfqhNMR90XxcMtdj9_WtJOXhVZKP8EMht4u-buBMXTP5n5j9EIfynFHYGCJaJG6gshpT3ucY-kaTY0ZtWg3_DowlxAMHYrpusapxXPJc2S85nrL36wAqil4ybz6vNsTTVDMLtBEI-gXzaZjchNF3fkrdL5fbn30_mDz9Jwk9BZBdnQD0s2UlCPgIbGOMWjQ9YaLtiHCwtXWpq4AQgdgDdSoZk_VdD8ozanlyYFqIjd62ru6E08rrqueEMNwPt0U9u0zQC8rF2WfqmyBCNZ8Pu4R6Ny2ykgLoaDnHx2kGtLs1S6TqGWOChG4zzw%3D)
---
| | Dear Friend,

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you.

More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a64cba9d0ca14a46907ae285b13ffdcf&_e=iSyR-7YQuDYywyDTQrxZMjk7RewT73zyC95PwdPrQrTXzEj4gtiFumtdhI5lgVSuh0jBmB99RpUu_lSb9XV0bIwf512LZT8452WSZfY4wNg9amJZfgfqhNMR90XxcMtdj9_WtJOXhVZKP8EMht4u-buBMXTP5n5j9EIfynFHYGCJaJG6gshpT3ucY-kaTY0ZtWg3_DowlxAMHYrpusapxXPJc2S85nrL36wAqil4ybz6vNsTTVDMLtBEI-gXzaZjJU_EQN9M0swLxSTSF9mzC1PHqlCDbR7eHNuQCJY5rj5Km5He7QAdLnWQccxfRco9A04iyIJZl9ROaNykWmMvPsDIC-Oc8CrrjcOhCorcaNSjASy7p-V3TxxlvJbrbhTJVUNeKhmPI14TizZpSJqMVrtO1gjx09ao6NN3HDe3_tw%3D) Like all our courses, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry"** contains stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case, hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

**For any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link below:

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/principles-of-chemistry](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a64cba9d0ca14a46907ae285b13ffdcf&_e=iSyR-7YQuDYywyDTQrxZMjk7RewT73zyC95PwdPrQrTXzEj4gtiFumtdhI5lgVSuh0jBmB99RpUu_lSb9XV0bIwf512LZT8452WSZfY4wNg9amJZfgfqhNMR90XxcMtdj9_WtJOXhVZKP8EMht4u-buBMXTP5n5j9EIfynFHYGCJaJG6gshpT3ucY-kaTY0ZtWg3_DowlxAMHYrpusapxXPJc2S85nrL36wAqil4ybz6vNsTTVDMLtBEI-gXzaZjUZ60gsGk7f6oEtmff_WAvqNw7y1MuIaTJptGEv1_9w9tBqrQYy7ayCmXHaTgj1zv4A9BGFFef-yz_hM2oatbKwMzoqUVljeCJXmvQ3F4CUmYusVQ80H1kTq5mdUxicu3z0O85tfDLCeV9vCz4rae1nuxT8jRFQtyMtF6u1PNMM0%3D)

The proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its Creator.

For these reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater appreciation for the world around us with **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Let's promote what's true about our world together.

Warm Regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

# MAGA's Project 2025: Attacking American Sustainability
---
| [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/maga-os?refcode=2025)
---
_**MAGA's Project 2025 is attacking American progress.**_ As detailed in the Project 2025 writings, MAGA wants to completely destroy all of the progress made in climate policy over the last 15 years! **WE NEED TO CALL THIS OUT!** 🚨 Here is one of the many direct quotes attacking sustainable policy: **"The next Administration should eliminate the Climate Hub Office and withdraw from climate change agreements that are inimical to the prosperity of the United States."** As outlined in the Project, the next Administration is encouraged to eliminate the Climate Hub Office and withdraw from climate change agreements perceived as detrimental to the prosperity of the United States. However, this shortsighted approach prioritizes short-term economic gains over the long-term sustainability of our planet, basically upending years of positive progress made on the environment. By dismantling initiatives aimed at combating climate change and withdrawing from international agreements, Project 2025 poses a grave threat to the health and well-being of future generations as well as the planet as a whole. The consequences of inaction on climate change are dire, and we cannot afford to ignore the urgent need for action. It is imperative that we come together to oppose Project 2025's regressive stance on climate change and advocate for policies that prioritize environmental sustainability. Our planet and future generations depend on it. We can make a more sustainable future with sustainable policy. This is something all Americans can agree on: we need to protect our environment at all costs. Together, we can make sure our government prioritizes our environment over profits for the elite. [**Join us in this critical battle to protect our nation from Trump’s authoritarian ambitions. Together, we can preserve the very essence of American democracy. This is Amy Brown – my husband Sam Brown just won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I first met my husband in the burn unit when he returned from Afghanistan after a roadside bomb exploded under his vehicle. There was one thing about Sam that caught my attention immediately. It wasn't the burns on his body, it wasn't the scars on the face. His vibrant faith in God glowed brightly even in his darkest days. Everyone who encountered him could see Sam is different. name: Colby Jenkins
subject: The single-most-offensive justification from my opponent
body:
We are patriots, we can’t be bought or bribed to trample on the Constitution or watch the country go over a fiscal cliff...
No images? [Click here](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-e-eddhiz-trihsurjy-yk/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-r/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-y/) Dear Friends,This is our final installment responding to my opponent's **[justification of her vote for the $1.2 trillion Schumer/Biden omnibus spending bill.](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-j/)** Since she is avoiding**[ our challenge for a series of debates](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-t/)**, side-by-side, where we stand before voters to discuss these important issues, we are offering a positive comparison in writing and by video. Today I will be discussing **her most offensive justification for her vote - she did it for the military!** : [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-i/) **MILITARY PAY RAISE****Celeste Claims** : Our soldiers will get just over a 5% pay raise.**Colby Claims** : As a member of the Armed Services who has worn the flag on my shoulder for nearly 30 years, led combat missions as the Commander of a Green Beret A-Team in Afghanistan, and led anti- drug operations across South America, and hostage rescue operations in Colombia, **this may be the single-most-offensive thing she said in defense of her vote.** I know the members of our military. I still wear the uniform. My daughter is currently at West Point. I have friends who are in the ground that I lost in the name of the Constitution that we swore to uphold and the nation we swore to defend.Do our soldiers deserve better pay and treatment? Absolutely.But we don't serve for the pay.**We are patriots, we can 't be bought or bribed to trample on the Constitution or watch the country go over a fiscal cliff with out-of-control spending and earmarks all while control of our own border is turned over to our enemies.**I think I speak for most everyone I know in the military when I say that, if those are the terms, then with all due respect Celeste, you can keep your money.I promise to you that as your Congressman, if a bill like this is given to me in the dead of night, my vote won't just be "no." It will be **HELL NO**.Thank you,Colby [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-d/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-n/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-p/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-x/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-m/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-q/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-a/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-f/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-z/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-v/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-e/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-s/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-g/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-w/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-yd/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eddhiz-trihsurjy-yh/) [ Share ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-fb-eddhiz-trihsurjy-yu/) [ Tweet ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-tw-eddhiz-trihsurjy-jl/) [ Share ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-li-eddhiz-trihsurjy-jr/) [ Forward ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-trihsurjy-F0A48A54-eddhiz-l-jy) | Paid for by Colby Jenkins for Congress You are receiving this email because you have been identified as an Utah voter, or you have subscribed through our website. I’m proud to run this campaign _the right way_ —with over 500,000 individual contributions from folks like you powering everything we do.

My opponent has the backing of shady billionaires and Mitch McConnell himself. Outside groups are flooding Montana with over **$50,000,000** in TV ads to try and defeat me.

I won’t lie, that’s a lot of cash. And it’s concerning—especially if we don’t have the resources to fight back. But I’d bet on this grassroots team any day of the week.

**Instead, they took every available action to block me from speaking and to prevent their conservative students from exercising their First Amendment rights to freedom of speech and assembly. **

The organization that invited me to speak - Young America's Foundation - is suing UCLA for this blatant violation of freedom of speech.

_All of this is having an effect on students ' opinions and attitudes today. _

Enough is enough. We need your support to help YAF win this lawsuit against UCLA and help fight for students' free speech rights nationwide.

YAF goes directly to high school and college campuses with the best speakers in the conservative movement, including **Ben Shapiro** , **Matt Walsh** , **Katie Pavlich** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , and many others so that students can freely express and engage with the values that make us free. YAF promotes your values, such as a strong national defense, individual freedom, limited government, and freedom of speech to large student audiences.

Young America's Foundation is taking a stand against UCLA's censorship of conservative free speech.

**YAF is suing UCLA and will take them to court so that students can hear the truth about Hamas --the truth that their school is fighting to keep from them. **

But they can't do this alone. UCLA has vast resources and teams of lawyers preparing to defend their excuse for shutting down a conservative lecture on campus.

**Will you give $50 right now to stand with the conservative students of UCLA and fight back?** We are looking for 76 Americans to step forward today with a gift to protect conservative free speech. **And** **every dollar you give will fuel our fight to ensure that students on EVERY campus can learn the truth about Israel, Hamas, and the freedoms that make America great. **

Here's the secure link where you can quickly make your gift: **[https://secure.yaf.org/ucla-lawsuit-protect-conservative-speech](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MTY3LTUzZTllZWE0YjNmNzRmZmU4MDg3N2QzYTIyM2U5YjFlIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3NlY3VyZS55YWYub3JnL3VjbGEtbGF3c3VpdC1wcm90ZWN0LWNvbnNlcnZhdGl2ZS1zcGVlY2g_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj11Y2xhX2xhd3N1aXRfYXBwZWFsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PTA1MjRfcm9iZXJ0c3BlbmNlcl9BRS1GRk81MDM3NSJ9/QbK9b_MBrrDeqkiI5IL65A)**

subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly.

| | | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zv5amggp8u688ab68qojk0vpk17ggs938083bs5o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gmaor2c9h2bs)
---
| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zet3lalv1ikmeeukpehuh0m2uf3kc2jsbg2cs890_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gmaor2c9h2bs)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1p1qbl3im8t0a2jf1rr5v002fmom1i976c8c02o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gmaor2c9h2bs) [No](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zchfkqbfnkgtv9ehenipjptnqh3sot9blsrm38a0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gmaor2c9h2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd85pgtsob9mir4ejk7mpki640ndv3nrdl48a04o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gmaor2c9h2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zj27bskjrj9t74g2ie7oeur7uo3hok97lbbuu7d8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gmaor2c9h2bs) For our children, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

name: Candace Owens, BLEXIT
subject: I support law and order. Do you?
body:
I am so grateful for our police officers.

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z6jk46gep47b52ie9b21t1uv7em916e3uk383ei0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)
---
Friend, **I am so grateful for our police officers. ** As an American who believes in law and order, truth, and justice, I have always stood with the public servants who protect our communities. **[Please join me in thanking uniformed men and women by signing our ‘Back the Blue Petition’ and letting brave officers know that we are grateful for their service and sacrifice.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zqfad5ilu5gfqpdesq3bd452b7bkaglb7d33mp0o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)**
---
[**Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z64vdbvjjq95hsaghbnaq9la7blb8ei8b48kctdo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)
---
Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began propelling criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to “ _defund the police_.” I refuse to accept that we must cater to the bottom denominator of our society and that the black community must fight and scream and demand support for the people in our community who are up to no good. That’s one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT — an organization focused on shifting the culture in Black America as well as educating and uplifting minorities through educational programs and acts of community service. **Around the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have supported local officers, while so many others have turned their backs on those who serve our communities. ** **[To join these chapters and stand with police officers, please sign the national petition today.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zhbc2qe9e9kav5r1b2m85v7c941gdke07d9c11lg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)**
---
[**Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z676fkfi11fo7gpi8ejnkr760h0kjn5forn27il8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5b9jk0sbn2dgtpllei74jjrq1lq606sv6slekm8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)
---
_This summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving back to the Baltimore Police Department and learned some history about the city’s police force._
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zhpslrilfctcnl2obb8d7h5vjkp0mp2loei7qe0g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)
---
_The first state chapter — BLEXIT North Carolina — paid a visit to local officers in July. Our State Director showered them with thank-you notes and delicious food as a token of BLEXIT’s appreciation._
---
**[If you ‘Back the Blue’ — and believe that we must support local heroes — please sign the national petition right away.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zcvrg9amgtv5mqfv59t2h61qe3g6qu257bu98fm8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)** While the ‘defund the police’ crowd wants us to think minorities stand with them — polls show that the vast majority of black voters (more than 80%) want police funding to stay the same or even increase. We’ve been sold a lot of lies by anti-police radicals — those lies have been a detriment to Black American culture, the country as a whole, and the police officers who fight for justice every day. **We must stop the deception that is harming urban communities and demeaning police around the nation. ** If you are an American, no matter what color you are, you should want law and you should want order. That is the way forward. **[Join me in letting our police officers know that you support law and order, justice, and their valiant efforts to keep our communities safe.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5m9vpevuu0kudjqiesqg5grqglj3c96t572uf60_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)**
---
[**Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ze0i3b7m1p8qcifgstb6ccma07nnjd4mei5g2ag0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj4clh2bs)
---
Candace OwensChair of BLEXITPowered by Turning Point USA

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zt3gpnva60tfs6mul02r4u7cm75lv45cabqmvk90_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj2clh2bs) [No](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfoue69lqm60bfn2cutu8vfu69kfllbhk6ednglg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj2clh2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4825636ouhmm98mnad4u25ia5l275hq2bq6abjg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5gm1pj2clh2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. body:

Hillsdale College

Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its
National Referendum on the Administrative State.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osLGYCLWNI

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

Hillsdale College has selected you to
participate in its National Referendum on the Administrative
State.

Responding will only take a few
minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right
away…because our country is facing a constitutional
crisis.

It's a crisis that involves a
fundamental political question: who rules whom?

The Constitution established a limited
government in which the people ruled through their elected
officials. Under this form of government, America became the
freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional

subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly.

| | | This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zr86d9pmn1lp4mqlueghpuf1498ofvti6j3r9od0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im8o34c5h2bs)

| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl2t66ro0gf05epdjtpumsk8khoc6ddh0ochmjgo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im8o34c5h2bs)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1odtur6poon7mvf73rt10ejeqjrimd24uf2u498_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im8o34c5h2bs) [No](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zku3i2qj2lutihsb2v9rfne7aog4hev4v6agbqlg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im8o34c5h2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjtghm6k036qdu2ppq38ncb2nbpgn64clchoohio_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im8o34c5h2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zks4ao8hh8im7j6dfdo4itbgdlu4lmr5tjq6dbq8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im8o34c5h2bs) For our children, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

This week, Governor Glenn Youngkin signed a comprehensive set of bipartisan bills passed this legislative session, marking Virginia's continued commitment to the Right Help, Right Now behavioral health transformation plan. These bipartisan legislative initiatives encompass enhancements to the behavioral health workforce and expanded support for individuals in crisis.

"This collaborative effort stands as a testament to Virginia's unwavering dedication to revolutionizing mental health services and accessibility. With fortified support for mental health professionals and steadfast commitment to timely crisis intervention, we're addressing critical needs of Virginians and raising the bar for the standard of care across the Commonwealth," Governor Youngkin said.

First Lady Suzanne S. Youngkin traveled to Colonial Heights, VA to attend a ribbon cutting ceremony for the expansion of Southside College of Health Sciences (SCHS). SCHS, originally founded in 1895, is deeply rooted in its community and provides quality education programs to individuals and offers flexible training options for today's students. Mrs. Youngkin toured the new simulation lab where students practice skills on lifelike mannequins that have advanced capabilities. The completion of the simulation lab increases enrollment opportunities for the community and helps bolster the healthcare workforce in the Tri-Cities areas. Every student is a hope for the future of the Commonwealth's healthcare.

This week, Governor Youngkin announced that Carry-On Trailer, a leading manufacturer of steel and utility trailers, will invest $9.2 million to increase capacity at its facility in Westmoreland County. Virginia successfully competed with Georgia and Pennsylvania for the project, which will create 60 new jobs.

"Carry-On has recognized that Virginia is the perfect location to serve their northeast customer base, and this latest expansion of high-quality manufacturing jobs solidifies a strong and successful partnership," Governor Youngkin said.

Recognized in June, Great Outdoors Month in the Commonwealth celebrates Virginia's extensive and growing outdoor recreation industry.

Experiencing record attendance levels last year, Virginia is home to 42 beautiful state parks. Among these is Natural Bridge, once referred to by Thomas Jefferson as "the most sublime of nature's works." Depicted by Sallie Aubrey Wise in her 1887 painting - recently restored by The Library of Virginia and available to view through the Art Experience - Natural Bridge has remained one of the Commonwealth's most popular attractions throughout #homehistory and into today.

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly.

| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ze2l35dgrctpk8evve96lke211v6ja8thgg9ss48_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im4o74s1h2bs)
---
| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z10tf8bm5e90ev9u0d10bv8821r6fou9pus54vjg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im4o74s1h2bs)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zkp8ph6h6sttjscp7dn7ac14v4m22mi3l5m2s760_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im4o74s1h2bs) [No](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zum630elj0l0ji2j3msrig256moi0s7b3npn7on8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im4o74s1h2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z354q5r0tpv0js3or3n6l7ialvvskremsb2r7dc0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im4o74s1h2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z2gla4v75cch2pkiu8kc0ht7pl7ji3df4jpdoglg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5im4o74s1h2bs) For our children, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly.

| | | This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zr6becin7v7c1k5u1gtc1eq55trdl79i3d33u250_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5imcpr2c3h2bs)
---
| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zeev0ig4p02img34p7bi4cqrb98pqi9vns962748_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5imcpr2c3h2bs)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvkqgtplra20luqmdt7ausdtntioc5mpe41hqdbg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5imcpr2c3h2bs) [No](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztarkb7gs84gpaqgn3f48lgkflpa5fppco3o733o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5imcpr2c3h2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zap5ct11o11s8tu656m2tlqtir2db8nevcdi64oo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5imcpr2c3h2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4nbt266ags87b63on5gf2tthmkk2ade5jmq1h50_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s5imcpr2c3h2bs) For our children, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly.

| | | This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ZHNptnv_6O4f0oLSMxavYw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoT_~~)
---
| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ZHNptnv_6O4f0oLSMxavYw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoT_~~)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ZHNptnv_6O4f0oLSMxavYw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoT_~~) [No](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ZHNptnv_6O4f0oLSMxavYw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoT_~~) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ZHNptnv_6O4f0oLSMxavYw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoT_~~)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ZHNptnv_6O4f0oLSMxavYw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoT_~~) For our children, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution? We need more citizens like you--informed citizens --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can't let that happen! That's why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand WHAT the Constitution says; HOW it relates to current issues and events; and WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty. If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable. That's because we're seeking 1,000 people in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to 10,000,000 Americans , and this initiative starts with you--YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what's best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the National Survey on the State of American Education **today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! For our children, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College Defend the Constitution PO Box 1188 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

## SCOTUS Strikes Down Ban on Bump Stocks
The U.S. Supreme Court ruled on Friday in a 6-3 decision that [a federal ban on bump stocks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu7CAUAL8Gd1hwzGNdUNzG3d42pYXx8S4JBovHovx9lJRRytE0o3m7r3frg4-P__ZEU4-0Wlf9C1dFuaQgVjHs5kAEnAY0XPObkLOCaXgaPWtAvd2YFMxJRK0dIptAOc7sNIvBG2AgmOKSM5i5Hqdd7gz1LI8b7kozIhjuvqY8vicf6xOP8JlemEeXziGYZ61XIdM_AguBpfc-xs1F7OXbE1iuFHz1rhBYSrsynkhdarn-ZppbwEIfLdKtnRctNbmPQjcbaYvB9qMFml20XAol-ZDNfnUfgi9KE8Eep_Xhp6j-_edl4CsAAP__T8Npug), gun accessories that allow semiautomatic rifles to fire more quickly, is unlawful. The Trump administration adopted the ban after the accessory [was used during](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u8yAUQJ_G3ojgcgF7YPiWbPnWjhY_l4QWG8vgRH37Kp07Hp3hSOfjttxcLnm7_3cr2Z7q4kLPT1o0E4oBLjhGm4iA5EhWGDGhmjXI8WGd0ajBCz25xJXnicSEoM0sZoSU4pgtcECuhRIcZmEuMqrIycwqTRS14QNyirnX4_JZ89YflMp3fdJxCXUdi330vrdB_hvgOsDV7Ru92lu94eg5FBrg2s79oJVYqOfR2f3cGvPnurPWa_hqzEsfhUehZTSTEuh0VC4E5RHD5GUcDxv3Vy4lN20G5PfV5fLb73_feFr4CQAA__8n_mCp) the 2017 mass shooting in Las Vegas. The majority opinion stated that bump stocks do not turn semiautomatic weapons into machine guns because each trigger depression in rapid succession still only releases one shot. The dissenting opinion argued that bump stocks should be classified as [machine guns](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2O3CAUQOGnwZ0tuOa3oEjjbtKmtBi4jEmwsQCPNW8f7dbbH-lI35_H-nApp-P12-1oeyyr8z29cZUjEyPwlQ_BRkTAeUDLFNNcGAnzsFnDlAiaSyPoU2gNM5WGOe09oEJv_JAsUOBUMsEoGKamOYhAURkRNQapKOEUQ-qlTn9LOvqGMX_KG-vkyz5ku_V-NjL_IrAQWO77nrYrxrO0_hUQWPDo9UNgaddZccfRl6v2sV4Z2_i89nNsvfh_bT1WKYUyjiPyJ9XRRMfmSLn3Q7XhvFPOqUlFOH3tLuXvff8Z423hfwAAAP__DYZhaw).
## Pentagon Ran Secret Campaign in China
A Reuters investigation revealed on Friday that the U.S. military [secretly ran a propaganda campaign](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQAL_GdKD1YvBd4eI1dPfalGhjL9xGBiPbB8rfR5c6zTRTjDQfj_lBEmVf_9PGri5pJl_l5Hls9dCimU0T3MKM3DfstNU3M9xH7JunGxkHWj7BazAGvO1R0xu9BwvG3xpxCGhg1IMGvGvb9WEIwPY-LDcOowVlgIPUlLuvJHt98hK_08m582lronvWehTV_1M4KZyu6-oyvyrn8vYKJ9lPLlVWqlwUTuVgLxTbzEfKVeH0KtT6dEpoj5wOWmkPpHBqsgvHJTFKGa0ysG4k8TdZ_x5wOvwJAAD__6BRXiE) during the COVID-19 pandemic to discredit China's Sinovac vaccine in the developing world. The campaign used at least 300 fake Twitter (now X), primarily in the Philippines, Central Asia, and the Middle East, to spread fear about China's vaccines and to curb Beijing's perceived growing influence. [The operation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7turDAQgOGnsTuQPb6tCxenodvTpkQTPLCOfEFgQfL2UVKn_Ztf39tzfmLKqW7_sVDoa5tx6emi2Q7SDKBnzWNYiYAUpyCdfGjjLSj-CkqZxTkv0Zro0Gt6V5LgYaOXqGKUPAUQoIWVRgrw0o0qmijIebM-KFonmBYUU2_H-NFS7S9a81e76BiXVngOr973k6l_DCYG033fP720Gg_Cco7t2BhMle6TwbRT7bi1OmDtabjwc1iw7Ji2yo8Q9zvlnE7rmBZbwZR_D_1v7xXgOwAA___XYFi2) began under former President Donald Trump in the spring of 2020 and continued for months under President Joe Biden, even after social media executives warned the new administration about the ongoing campaign. It was eventually halted in [the spring of 2021](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO3CAQANCvwR0WHoOxC4ookruN0qW0ZmFYJodh5eVs7d9fc-V9wZPev9t2Q85cHn9wJ9di3dA3Pmmb5GAk6E13wUUioLEjN9hh1maZYOySi2i0HT1gCHcNVgek-7xEb2ZlKS6mYwcKtJoGMyhYBtuPwQRFdjFxpjBZJbSiwK0e_f_KpSWK-V1POnpf9y671NrzJcZfAlYB63VdfUDO7x059772nx8C1kSYWxKw4tHYZ5LDaEYFyyJg_Uul4aMW-SJ_UJO-nhzkid5zIfk7cUH5xBJoZ9-ntufucOF5cc78mqzQ6vFN7V37ueZ08BUAAP__SmxnSA).
## Wild Hogs Wreak Havoc Across U.S.
Wild hogs are causing [widespread destruction](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFvhCAUwPFPAxsEnoA6MHRxu64dDSeP87UoF6WS-_ZNk47d__kPv4_bfAuUaX-8hw19TWUOS6ULZye0FWBmw6NPiIAdR697PRg7Ouj46uN4tyn1NiTrlhTsiEa7EIeIA4BRhpMHBUY5bbWCUfeyizYq7EebBoyuV8wojFTLIT8L7XXFlF_lwkMuZePZr7U-T9a9MZgYTK01GQPl1xYoy6XI7y8G047tZDCFo9KSUejOqk4P429POYq1PE5B-xVOKrtIeIQszkY7invZ7nKtW-aHj89GOdPpembU4--_8fq_x-XhJwAA__-4k2Mj) across at least 35 states in the U.S. These invasive animals, first brought to Florida by Spanish settlers in the 1500s, are responsible for significant agricultural damage, garden destruction, and, in some cases, attacks on humans. [Here's a video](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vgzAUAH-N2UD2wx948NCFLV07Isc8h1cIjsC1xb-v0rnbSTecdF-36eZpo_3x6Z_ockyTD5kKTroVqgU5yWZ2ERGwb9AJIwaprIa-WZxRd-RB3WUEo6O10nIZB21j4MHb3jbkgIPkWijBwQrT9bOaORqr4oCzNpxJjjPldHTfifa8YNyuVPDoQno2m1tyfp2s_2AwMhhrrV1dr_yWDEbg0DMYhXjzwGCkvfiTCrbnCwPh2dYD_Ur7o118SaFdcc8_Yb0YjM3h5lelbaNTGyb54-lp-4vm_xcUB78BAAD__8njXPo). Statistics show that they kill [more people annually than sharks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOpSAUQL8GOwxeAbWg2Mbubbul4clF74pigEjm7ydv6qlOcZqT8--1vCwFura_9kRTfFzsWujBRfNOcZCLbJzxiIB9g6YbulGqSUPf7MZrDW-l3l7KXvcjCD-pFb1dRy8nqbAhAwKk0J3qBEzd0PZOOYHDpPyITg-CSYGOSkzt_0hX2dGHr_hgatd4NsHspdyZ9X8YzAzmWmtrt4rvj2UwX1gzgznQg7nE9WAw3zF9UCk4ftOW-UEh8DMm5DfGOyDPu01H5nmP60HXxi-sPGFGm9adJ3zQhtwk4-5KIVDWA5NiOy2Fn6Ty-6DHwHcAAAD___ngauA). Ohio is [considering legislation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OqzAUhJ_GdCD7-A8KF7dxl9tuiRx8DGfl2BE4QXn7FVtvNdJopPn0fd3mW6BMZf0fHuhaqnNYGr1xNr3QPahZddElREDZoRNWjEpPBmS3ObBmgbsUSY4qqUUuKgBok6Y0hmXUvCMHHBQ3QgsOk7CDjDpytJNOI0ZjOVMcI7W6D9-VStsw5U994z4s9dFlt7X2PJj8x8Az8Od5Dq8jtBrD5xow8Eer-4eBL3geV4RGtTDw1y0Dzw0DLyQDfw-lUFn7hHvI_VbXfnuVdjVU-rpRZeCt4haskJxbBr7bXXyelDMdxjLF10eg_MvV_rb0dvATAAD__-gPZlg) that would allow landowners to shoot the feral swine without a license.

# WE won the Primary!
---

Hello Peter, The emphasis is on "WE". I have so many to thank... First and foremost, I am deeply grateful to God. I felt His guiding hand and constant presence throughout this campaign. I heeded his son's words to 'Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness...' Next, I want to thank Lesly, who has stood by me for over three years of campaigning. She wouldn't choose this for herself, but her love for me and our country inspires her to step outside her comfort zone. And to the hundreds of volunteers and thousands of supporters who voted for me: Your dedication and hard work have not gone unnoticed. Thank you for being the backbone of our true grassroots campaign. We were outspent by more than 500% by one competitor, but our team of dedicated, selfless women and men outworked all others. Your efforts have been instrumental in our victory. Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! I'm also grateful to the other Republican Candidates. Michael Boris, you ran a clean and honest campaign. Your integrity is commendable. Flemming Larsen, your hard work pushed me to work harder. You both have made me a better candidate, and I respect you for that. We must now come together to defeat Dina Titus. She has already begun her mud-slinging campaign against me. This morning, the DCCC sent out a post calling me extreme. Titus can't run on her dismal record, so she will resort to lies, innuendos, and deceit. How We Win the General In the 2022 election, Titus squeaked by with just 51.6% of the vote - the lowest percentage of all other Democrats who won Congressional elections in Nevada. We proved we can beat Titus. We beat Titus in Henderson. We beat Titus in Boulder City. We beat Titus by 20 points with in-person voters. Her very narrow victory was only because of Democrat ballot harvesting and mail-in voting. Like Ronald Reagan and Abraham Lincoln, who also lost their first elections, we will use the lessons learned in 2022 to win in 2024. Here's how...
* Republicans must embrace early voting, mail-in voting, and voter assistance. Until we can change the laws, we will use them to our advantage. Republican leaders, at all levels, are encouraging us to "bank our vote" by voting early.

* Personal contact with Republicans who didn't vote. Titus' margin of victory over me and the Libertarian candidate was just over 7,000 votes, yet 46,000 registered Republicans did not vote. We have their contact information and an army of volunteers to encourage them to vote in this year's general.

* Capitalize on our momentum. Democrats are not excited about a dazed and confused Joe Biden or his strongest supporter, Dina Titus. Republicans are excited and energized to retire Biden and expand our majority in Congress. We will capitalize on this enthusiasm and momentum by getting more people involved in our Get Out the Vote (GOTV) efforts.

* Expand our base. In 2022, we spent a lot of time in our Hispanic communities. A large percentage of the votes I received came from independent and non-partisan voters. We will double our outreach efforts to bring voters into our coalition.

The last election was the first time I've run for public office. Voters now know who I am. We will capitalize on the goodwill, name recognition, and lessons learned in 2022 to win in 2024.
Please reply to this email to join our Army of Volunteers to put America first and take back our country!

| Peter, As we head into summer, I wanted to update you with legislative happenings and what is ahead in the coming months. Between the tension of striving to reverse the VMSDEP decision that was made in the General Assembly on May 13th and my trip to Israel with other state legislators under the delegation of CAM (Combat Anti-Semitism), my summer is starting with great fervor.
---
| | |
---
| On June 7th, I joined a group of like-minded conservatives (including Lieutenant Governor Winsome Earle-Sears and Delegate A.C. Cordoza) from across the nation to head to the war-torn country of Israel in hopes of standing in solidarity with their cause and gaining a better understanding of what they are facing. My time here has not been without concern; but we remain safe and steadfast in our determination to do what we can to assist Israel in their time of need. While in Israel, the first of 3 VMSDEP task force meetings occurred. My Legislative Director attended in my stead to sit on the panel and hear a great number of Virginia veterans deliver a staunch message: VMSDEP is **_not_** an entitlement. I have filed a bill to completely repeal the changes made to VMSDEP and ensure our veteran population is taken care of - but I need your help in petitioning Senate Democratic Leadership to ensure they let my bill be heard.

clean_body: If you opened this email because you remember my playing days with the Dodgers and the Padres, thank you. | | | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot, If you opened this email because you remember my playing days with the Dodgers and the Padres, thank you. | | Having you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees... ...well, as they say, "Those were the days." But this email isn't about baseball. In fact, it's a email I never thought I'd be writing to you. | | | As of March 5th, it's official. I'm going head-to-head with Adam Schiff in November. Democrat policies have brought America to its knees. There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And that's why I'm running for Senate. We Republicans pulled our country out of the 1970's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan. And I believe we can do it again by putting classic conservative values at the heart of everything we do. But there is no way I can pull it off without you. I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -\- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. I'm fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake -- I'm not just taking the field for Californians. When we win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. Thank you and God Bless, | | Steve Garvey Republican for United States Senate | | | | | | | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE PO Box 532389 Los Angeles, CA 90053-2389 | | | Conservatives Give PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

| | | | | Peter: With the general election officially underway, here’s the update on Pennsylvania’s Senate race that you need to hear, not the one you want to hear: FIRST: David McCormick, a hedge fund executive from Connecticut, launched his campaign to defeat Bob. THEN: Right-wing super PACs and Wall Street billionaires quickly rallied behind him, spending millions to flood the airwaves in an attempt to buy this critical Senate seat. NOW: David McCormick is officially the Republican nominee, and the full force of the Republican party, including Donald Trump, is all in to flip PA red. If Bob loses, Democrats don’t have a shot in hell to protect the Senate and the White House. That means kissing any chance of protecting women’s rights, workers’ rights, and voting rights goodbye. [I’ll be damned if we screw this up, so here’s what I need from you, Peter. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: The truth about education standards in Mississippi
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/educationstandards?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**Mississippi’s Department of Education was quick to trumpet an improvement in education standards in our state this week.** According to a gushing press release they put out, Mississippi has risen up the national education rankings from 48th to 30th over the past decade.

“Great!” you might think. “It’s wonderful to see an improvement in education standards in Mississippi”.

**But has there really been an improvement? **

The Department of Education pronouncement was based on a recently released report from the Annie E. Casey Foundation, which itself used data from the US Department of Education’s National Assessment of Education Progress (NAEP). The Annie E. Casey report (page 39) based its claims on two metrics in particular; 4th grade proficiency in reading and 8th grade proficiency in math.

**_I took a closer look at the NAEP data, and it is clear that any improvements in Mississippi’s education ranking owe more to a decline in standards in other states, rather than to any substantive improvements in our own._**
**THE TRUTH ABOUT 4 TH GRADE READING SCORES**
Between 2015 and 2022, Mississippi went from 46th for 4th grade reading to 18th. Progress!

The average 4th grade NAEP score in reading, however, only changed from 214 to 217.

**In other words, the improvement in ranking in 4th grade reading scores since 2015 is almost entirely a reflection of the fact that standards fell in other states. **

Here is a graph that shows the percentage of 4th grade students in Mississippi and America that are at or above proficiency in reading.
---
|
---
**_4th grade reading - percentage at or above proficient_**
| What do you notice?

**There clearly has been an improvement in the percentage of 4 th graders proficient in reading in Mississippi – _but it happened before 2019._ **It almost certainly reflects the enactment of a package of literacy laws in 2013, which shifted the way Mississippians teach reading towards phonics, rather than any change in policies since.

There has not been progress in the past five years, and any change in our ranking reflects the fact that other states have just done worse than we have.
**THE TRUTH ABOUT 8 TH GRADE MATH SCORES**
In 2022, Mississippi ranked 44th in 8th grade NAEP math, compared to 46th in 2015. Not only was there little relative improvement, the state’s average NAEP 8th grade math score actually fell from 271 in 2015 to 266 in 2022.

Here’s a graph that shows the percentage of 8th grade students in Mississippi and America that are at or above proficiency in math.
---
|
---
**_8th grade math - percentage at or above proficient_**
| What do you notice?

There has been an improvement, but most of that progress was made before 2013. Over the past decade the dark blue bars on the chart have flatlined.

It is profoundly misleading to present evidence of Mississippi’s relative improvement as evidence of any kind of absolute rise in standards.
**FACTS, NOT PROPAGANDA**
Here are some facts that the Department of Education could have included in their press release, but didn’t:

* **82 percent of 8 th grade kids in Mississippi were not proficient math in 2022. **
* **69 percent of 4 th grade kids in Mississippi were not proficient in reading in 2022**
* **Almost 4 in 10 fourth graders in 2022 did not even reach the _basic_ reading standard.**

---
|
---
**_Instead of propaganda, the Department of Education could take a look at its own data which shows that almost one in four Mississippi students — 108,000 children — are chronically absent from school._**

The rate of chronic absenteeism has in fact skyrocketed from 70,275 in 2016-17 to 108,310 in 2022-23.

“So what?” you might say. “Of course, officials are going to present what they do in the most positive light”.

**It matters deeply because until we have an honest conversation about the true state of education in our state, we aren’t going to see the changes Mississippi desperately needs.**
|
---
_**The Governors of Alabama, Arkansas and Louisiana - they've all successfully championed universal school choice.**_
| Mississippi is now surrounded on three sides by states that have embraced universal school choice. In Arkansas, Alabama and Louisiana, the money will follow the child. Families in those states will get control over their child’s share of state education funds.

**__Change only came about because there was a recognition of reality, and realization that reform was urgent and essential. __**

The reason there has been so little progress towards school choice in our state is because too many policy makers believe our education system is doing better than it actually is.
---

---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

body:
As an American who believes in law and order, truth, and justice, I have always stood with the public servants who protect our communities.

| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fivbq23PC8Xmz2AJIxt91Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoUBh6P0RgaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVJPTjUwMzYwVwNzcGNCCmZnxX9tZhiYIOVSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)

Friend, **I am so grateful for our police officers. ** As an American who believes in law and order, truth, and justice, I have always stood with the public servants who protect our communities. **[Please join me in thanking uniformed men and women by signing our ‘Back the Blue Petition’ and letting brave officers know that we are grateful for their service and sacrifice.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fivbq23PC8Xmz2AJIxt91Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoUBh6P0RgaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVJPTjUwMzYwVwNzcGNCCmZnxX9tZhiYIOVSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**
---
[**Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fivbq23PC8Xmz2AJIxt91Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoUBh6P0RgaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVJPTjUwMzYwVwNzcGNCCmZnxX9tZhiYIOVSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
---
Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began propelling criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to “ _defund the police_.” I refuse to accept that we must cater to the bottom denominator of our society and that the black community must fight and scream and demand support for the people in our community who are up to no good. That’s one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT — an organization focused on shifting the culture in Black America as well as educating and uplifting minorities through educational programs and acts of community service. **Around the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have supported local officers, while so many others have turned their backs on those who serve our communities. ** **[To join these chapters and stand with police officers, please sign the national petition today.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fivbq23PC8Xmz2AJIxt91Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoUBh6P0RgaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVJPTjUwMzYwVwNzcGNCCmZnxX9tZhiYIOVSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**
---
[**Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fivbq23PC8Xmz2AJIxt91Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoUBh6P0RgaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVJPTjUwMzYwVwNzcGNCCmZnxX9tZhiYIOVSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
---
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fivbq23PC8Xmz2AJIxt91Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoUBh6P0RgaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVJPTjUwMzYwVwNzcGNCCmZnxX9tZhiYIOVSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)

_This summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving back to the Baltimore Police Department and learned some history about the city’s police force._
---
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fivbq23PC8Xmz2AJIxt91Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoUBh6P0RgaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVJPTjUwMzYwVwNzcGNCCmZnxX9tZhiYIOVSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)

_The first state chapter — BLEXIT North Carolina — paid a visit to local officers in July. Our State Director showered them with thank-you notes and delicious food as a token of BLEXIT’s appreciation._
---
**[If you ‘Back the Blue’ — and believe that we must support local heroes — please sign the national petition right away.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fivbq23PC8Xmz2AJIxt91Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoUBh6P0RgaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVJPTjUwMzYwVwNzcGNCCmZnxX9tZhiYIOVSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** While the ‘defund the police’ crowd wants us to think minorities stand with them — polls show that the vast majority of black voters (more than 80%) want police funding to stay the same or even increase. We’ve been sold a lot of lies by anti-police radicals — those lies have been a detriment to Black American culture, the country as a whole, and the police officers who fight for justice every day. **We must stop the deception that is harming urban communities and demeaning police around the nation. ** If you are an American, no matter what color you are, you should want law and you should want order. That is the way forward. **[Join me in letting our police officers know that you support law and order, justice, and their valiant efforts to keep our communities safe.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fivbq23PC8Xmz2AJIxt91Q~~/AARclAA~/RgRoUBh6P0RgaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPVJPTjUwMzYwVwNzcGNCCmZnxX9tZhiYIOVSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

That’s one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT — an organization focused on shifting the culture in Black America as well as educating and uplifting minorities through educational programs and acts of community service. Around the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have supported local officers, while so many others have turned their backs on those who serve our communities. This summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving back to the Baltimore Police Department and learned some history about the city’s police force. The first state chapter — BLEXIT North Carolina — paid a visit to local officers in July. Our State Director showered them with thank-you notes and delicious food as a token of BLEXIT’s appreciation. While the ‘defund the police’ crowd wants us to think minorities stand with them — polls show that the vast majority of black voters (more than 80%) want police funding to stay the same or even increase. We’ve been sold a lot of lies by anti-police radicals — those lies have been a detriment to Black American culture, the country as a whole, and the police officers who fight for justice every day. We must stop the deception that is harming urban communities and demeaning police around the nation. If you are an American, no matter what color you are, you should want law and you should want order. That is the way forward. Candace OwensChair of BLEXITPowered by Turning Point USA Restore Our Nation PO Box 1177 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | ~~_

**The administrative state embodies an antithetical idea of sovereignty and power.** It centralizes and unifies the three branches of government into one monolith. It embodies the idea that sovereignty is derived not from the consent of the governed but from the divine right of expertise—namely, that power is the legitimate right of those who possess specialized knowledge in the mechanics of governance and economics. As a corollary, it embodies the notion that power is its own mandate for those who are intelligent and skilled enough to acquire it. Power is the private property of those wealthy enough to buy or savvy enough to secure a share, and therefore may be directed to private ends such as personal enrichment.

body:
| **_An Emergency Letter from the Desk of the House GOP Chair_**
---
Friend,
---
For the first time in the history of the United States, a sitting American president has orchestrated the sham prosecution of his leading opponent for the White House.
---
**Crooked Joe Biden is on the cusp of _canceling_ _out_ _your_ _vote_ by turning _YOUR_ nominee into a POLITICAL PRISONER. **
---
Without our votes, we are no more than PRISONERS to the Third-World Biden **_regime_** , trapped in a RIGGED system that casts you aside and discards your vision for America.
---
If Biden is allowed to get away with this, we may never have a free and fair election again!
---
**But some on the Left want to go further than just stripping us of our votes. These unhinged radicals want to _literally_ turn MAGA supporters like us into political prisoners! **
---
**My Democrat opponent has openly stated she wants to put Trump supporters like YOU in “re-education” camps – and so far, Democrat leaders have _REFUSED_ to condemn these vile remarks. **
---
These are the kind of unhinged extremists we’re up against, Friend. They hate President Trump, they hate our movement, but most of all, they hate hardworking Americans like us.
---
_And they’re more than willing to weaponize America’s justice system to __**JAIL**__ their political opponents in order to stay in power. _
---
**It starts with President Trump – but YOU will be the next target.**
---
When I say that our __free__ Republic is on the ballot in November, I’m not exaggerating.
---
**Fortunately, there’s one thing these tyrants can’t stop – no matter how many vicious attacks, witch hunts, and sham criminal trials they throw at President Trump.**
---
And that’s the movement of more than **_75 MILLION_** Americans who are so disgusted by this tyranny that they’ll send President Trump back to the White House in a landslide!
---
At the end of the day, YOU will deliver the _**_REAL_**_ verdict in President Trump’s trial with your vote on November 5th.
---
**_As House GOP Chair, it’s my responsibility to marshal the votes and the resources we need to send Donald J. Trump back to the White House._**
---
That’s why I’m asking you a simple question, Friend: Will YOU take a stand against this tyranny today by confirming that YOU will vote for President Trump?
---

Thank you and God bless,

Bobby Kennedy needs your immediate help to put him on the national stage for the first presidential debate hosted by CNN.
Give me a minute to explain. Then please take the critical actions outlined below to do your part to help out.
CNN, ABC, and the other Big Media Barons think they can undermine democracy by blocking RFK Jr. from the presidential debates. They are playing with your vote.
The fact is federal law requires “objective criteria to determine which candidates may participate in a debate.” ...
_OBJECTIVE_ criteria!
Well, there’s absolutely NOTHING objective about the criteria CNN is using to try and keep RFK Jr. off the June 27 debate stage.RFK Jr. meets the requirements to be on 19 state ballots, _which is enough signatures for 278 electoral votes_. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1535%2E135344%2EVFiTSM)

Friend -
Later today, Donald Trump will take the stage at the Turning Point Action conference in Detroit, Michigan. It's already his sixth visit in the 2024 race.
First, let's state the obvious: there is no winning the White House in 2024 without winning Michigan. That goes for Joe Biden, and that goes for Donald Trump.
Second, the better Elissa Slotkin does, the worse Trump does. That's why he attacked her directly during his last visit, calling her a “far-left liberal lunatic.”
But what does today's trip mean?
This trip will be the next of many because Trump knows he needs to keep his supporters consistently motivated between now and November. Every time he visits he gets more volunteer activity and he gets more media attention -- both things he wants for his campaign.
It's also a chance for him to rally and organize more Michigan donors, the small-dollar ones and the deep-pocketed ones that will fund huge independent expenditures in the state.
All of this impacts our race.
If someone turns out for Trump, there is a decent chance they are turning out for the Republican nominee in our Senate race.
But we are not powerless in this campaign.
Because every person we turn out in our race is also likely a vote to keep Trump out of the White House. And the truth is, we have always done better than most Democrats do in some of those "redder" parts of the state.
So this is a big moment for us. We need to do our best to match the energy Trump generates for Republicans in Michigan. Because it is not just our race and control of the Senate for Democrats on the line in Michigan, but it's also the White House.
So please:

Fellow American,

You may already know who I am from my time in Congress serving North Carolina's 8th District. Or you may be coming across me for the first time. Either way, I'm glad to be reaching out to you, and I think this could be the beginning of a great relationship. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: What I firmly believe
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I swore an oath to defend the Constitution when I joined the Marines. I took that oath seriously. And I was ready to honor that oath on the floor of the Capitol on January 6th.
#

Peter —
There are a few things I firmly believe:
**First, that this country is full of good people.**
I never would’ve made it to college without my community supporting me, I never would’ve survived Iraq without the guys I fought with, and our campaign never would’ve made it this far without supporters like you.
**Second, that those people deserve leaders who will work in good faith to improve their lives.**
That’s why I decided to run for the U.S. Senate. Because for years I’ve watched as the people of my community were let down by our leaders. They deserve better.
**And third, that our Constitution, our democracy, is sacred.**
I swore an oath to defend the Constitution when I joined the Marines. I took that oath seriously. And I was ready to honor that oath on the floor of the Capitol on January 6th.
Look: We’ve got to win in Arizona to win the Senate, and I have an important deadline tonight. I need your help to catch up on our goals and take back Arizona’s U.S. Senate seat. So, I’m humbly asking:
[**Make a $3 donation to my campaign today, before our mid-month deadline at midnight. I need your support to win in Arizona.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240615-1-160&t=1&akid=2483%2E734936%2Ea7rJ6a)

Now, Kari Lake... she doesn’t believe any of that.

She shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate. But if we’re not careful, she could defeat me. And it could be Kari Lake representing Arizona while Trump sits in the Oval Office.
**We can’t let that happen.**
I know you’re as fired up as anyone. If you’re ready to defeat Kari Lake and hold the U.S. Senate this November, please:

#

❗ Friends -
To everyone who cares about the movement for gun safety, please don't skip this important message.

Yesterday, the Supreme Court struck down the ATF’s ban on bump stocks.
Bump stocks are accessories that turn semi-automatic weapons into fully automatic machine guns.

Bump stocks are a grave threat to public safety, and the Supreme Court’s decision to strike down this ban is absolutely shameful.
Countless lives are at risk, and we will be doing all that we can to demand Congress to take federal action and reinstate a ban on these dangerous accessories.
But that work takes resources from supporters like you.

Today is a pivotal day for our organization: our mid-month fundraising drive ends tonight at midnight. We still have a ways to go to hit our mid-month goals.
The stakes are even higher this month, since we’re also rapidly coming up on our June 30th quarterly fundraising deadline.
This quarterly deadline is especially critical. Our gun lobby adversaries—who are currently jumping for joy about the Supreme Court’s decision yesterday—will be scanning our numbers to see if our movement is strong enough to take them on.

99% of people won't give today; they'll simply click away.
But if everyone getting this email donated even $1, we'd have the resources we need to show that our movement is stronger than ever.

[**If you’re ready to make an incredible impact on our movement for gun safety, please contribute $3 to GIFFORDS PAC today, or select an amount below. Our average online donation is around $23. Some of their colleagues were trying to make it harder for voters to amend Missouri’s constitution at the ballot box — all in an effort aimed at weakening our democracy and thwarting an upcoming potential ballot measure on abortion rights. Those lawmakers would rather stifle voters’ voices by changing the rules than actually listen to the people they were elected to serve. With your support, the fair maps movement had the backs of the senators who filibustered — and democracy won. Together, we defeated an attempt to require up to 75% approval from voters for a ballot measure to pass. Now, if it feels like we're playing a game of whack-a-mole, it's no coincidence.
