[](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=be5521e600ef4a35b7e23f7fb41b8ede&_e=vi3PWPUMtQ4RlEUV4HZWDigW_z-BawCwtRbsKNCoe9Z-7z8gH0EDPcWRpwg0ubCHCv078wu5mmzwzlEcufHX7Xzcjnng4n58BdlYlUVg4Qyi3ZI0bTe3uShaMfYpYeCEMjJwwE_DWgO-smWGwf_pcZG2Y2pJ1Ud_4oNV2oWnhsPpvqcyNY4ghJk3PGtW6TeAhNkrCzrBLRIK1jncbZEYsJfiTo7rG5u58ohV0sHoMSjs-ZLtW2cFbCSg0oM3Kt6EsWMjAmOt-hEeFB62S22BhpqCrn7TPupuXIaWhgetszQhwTO6LZKR5zIM5rngI3wFjiDqH7bOHYUcBrYU49m6Y3RIMP_r3ggh_I8vCwBIKgPdkTU8VHf0J7mDRZe3k7pEESa9lzE7pzR3Ap9jdgvz1RF_7R_jF61ONVum7btlHTo%3D) Dear Fellow American, Thanks for opening my email. I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=be5521e600ef4a35b7e23f7fb41b8ede&_e=vi3PWPUMtQ4RlEUV4HZWDigW_z-BawCwtRbsKNCoe9Z-7z8gH0EDPcWRpwg0ubCHCv078wu5mmzwzlEcufHX7Xzcjnng4n58BdlYlUVg4Qyi3ZI0bTe3uShaMfYpYeCEMjJwwE_DWgO-smWGwf_pcZG2Y2pJ1Ud_4oNV2oWnhsPpvqcyNY4ghJk3PGtW6TeAhNkrCzrBLRIK1jncbZEYsJfiTo7rG5u58ohV0sHoMSjs-ZLtW2cFbCSg0oM3Kt6EsWMjAmOt-hEeFB62S22Bhv66mFHHNHo5dRVKt_22N0v3AZX_fVJfkKfaZfcOOsjvSLWh4pTlR8koEONFj-0VklxsXfpyD_kTMXxc-OuFfTJ2-x22Yexft1RagjS1ji3NvcX-TubxMZ_uCfj5mw-CkQXeE-FtMidiIh1TsR6b34s%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the **Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights**. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. **That 's why we've turned our online course, ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=be5521e600ef4a35b7e23f7fb41b8ede&_e=vi3PWPUMtQ4RlEUV4HZWDigW_z-BawCwtRbsKNCoe9Z-7z8gH0EDPcWRpwg0ubCHCv078wu5mmzwzlEcufHX7Xzcjnng4n58BdlYlUVg4Qyi3ZI0bTe3uShaMfYpYeCEMjJwwE_DWgO-smWGwf_pcZG2Y2pJ1Ud_4oNV2oWnhsPpvqcyNY4ghJk3PGtW6TeAhNkrCzrBLRIK1jncbZEYsJfiTo7rG5u58ohV0sHoMSjs-ZLtW2cFbCSg0oM3Kt6EsWMjAmOt-hEeFB62S22BhvZ5uqKgrHntq_9nyozF7EzMmANre7Tmxo8RTlMpS8vTUWCbgu-9VrhVqs6ieIuXuWCiW56f-gvIN11pxx9Nkwpj_1WLgJ7Jg1JFGaWW2jx58J6QBAMojBNv1ejivWfvHja_GTFngd7PCF6nlrGjUXk%3D) into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy.** **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. We produced this course to restore the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among our young people--essential to restoring free government. You'll be excited to learn that **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," which tells people, especially children, that America is essentially an unjust nation--the opposite of our nation's unifying principles. Today, you can claim a DVD copy of ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=be5521e600ef4a35b7e23f7fb41b8ede&_e=vi3PWPUMtQ4RlEUV4HZWDigW_z-BawCwtRbsKNCoe9Z-7z8gH0EDPcWRpwg0ubCHCv078wu5mmzwzlEcufHX7Xzcjnng4n58BdlYlUVg4Qyi3ZI0bTe3uShaMfYpYeCEMjJwwE_DWgO-smWGwf_pcZG2Y2pJ1Ud_4oNV2oWnhsPpvqcyNY4ghJk3PGtW6TeAhNkrCzrBLRIK1jncbZEYsJfiTo7rG5u58ohV0sHoMSjs-ZLtW2cFbCSg0oM3Kt6EsWMjAmOt-hEeFB62S22Bhia5IE9qUZk-6Nf3-0r39d1l4ZyUh7Ss6aHdg9aI2Sf9EnlwFhBCh9EprHrIYCrr4qNYmUnvCZZHoruvjV78g38MIQWTHcYixmAAj3GjPWIHVDe3peyngkVOAoYLpRhAaxiYYgW7l0jFGDT86zttZ1k%3D) for your home library or give it as a gift. **Presenting real American history is the surest means of preserving liberty.** Quantities are limited, so reserve your copy today. [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-great-american-story-dvd](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=be5521e600ef4a35b7e23f7fb41b8ede&_e=vi3PWPUMtQ4RlEUV4HZWDigW_z-BawCwtRbsKNCoe9Z-7z8gH0EDPcWRpwg0ubCHCv078wu5mmzwzlEcufHX7Xzcjnng4n58BdlYlUVg4Qyi3ZI0bTe3uShaMfYpYeCEMjJwwE_DWgO-smWGwf_pcZG2Y2pJ1Ud_4oNV2oWnhsPpvqcyNY4ghJk3PGtW6TeAhNkrCzrBLRIK1jncbZEYsJfiTo7rG5u58ohV0sHoMSjs-ZLtW2cFbCSg0oM3Kt6EsWMjAmOt-hEeFB62S22BhjRnEvfb1_LeTnjHrVr5VqtPho_xFbPayBKEdrhljG_nfkTQCGHf-A_i74uQqlkvnGOD4c2sxSgYaMd5JkCT0QUWBPs96ccn6sQ74Lp1ZDTAtD2sdIEiqQhDeMMkYWQ8Bp3pG5Fgxp1tUkqZ5Zi0uPw%3D) Thank you for your partnership with Hillsdale College and for supporting its mission on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College **P.S.** Despite what _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project" says, our nation's history is unifying. That's why we've produced a full, unbiased account of America's past with **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"** now available on DVD. You can receive your copy with your generous tax-deductible gift of $100 or more using this secure link: [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-great-american-story-dvd](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=be5521e600ef4a35b7e23f7fb41b8ede&_e=vi3PWPUMtQ4RlEUV4HZWDigW_z-BawCwtRbsKNCoe9Z-7z8gH0EDPcWRpwg0ubCHCv078wu5mmzwzlEcufHX7Xzcjnng4n58BdlYlUVg4Qyi3ZI0bTe3uShaMfYpYeCEMjJwwE_DWgO-smWGwf_pcZG2Y2pJ1Ud_4oNV2oWnhsPpvqcyNY4ghJk3PGtW6TeAhNkrCzrBLRIK1jncbZEYsJfiTo7rG5u58ohV0sHoMSjs-ZLtW2cFbCSg0oM3Kt6EsWMjAmOt-hEeFB62S22Bhj_tJQSpFHsXmab_B2nIttdCqY0UDMVFEii0J5HNup984JjycXVuMeI8KDw5TJuFvmWlkttYeH46u8Zk0tG6R9tF1QDEUngp0OwFhoJ6iH9Vz7ZWG9KJEhUD-k3Y-ZU89p_D2FxG_6BRjz5xusWJa40%3D) Act today because quantities are limited! Thank you so much for helping us promote intelligent patriotism--especially among younger Americans. |

body:
#
Friend — $5.
We’ve been working hard this year to support changemaking candidates in crucial races around the country and help them win big this November.
And we’ve been able to boost some incredible progressive campaigns thanks to the folks on this grassroots team who chip in to fund our efforts.
But with our FEC fundraising deadline quickly approaching, we may soon have to make some difficult decisions.
That’s because right now, we’re currently on track to fall short of our FEC fundraising goals. And if we don’t turn things around, we’ll have to reevaluate our budget and decide what races we want to prioritize with both our time and money.

body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52575?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]Photo of Jon Hamm.

Hey Peter,
it’s Jon Hamm.

There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year
that I think you need to know about.

So before I ask you to chip in toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to
defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me
explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52575?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY

Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story
resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real
value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.

Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical
bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and
neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join
the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so
much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and
Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.

Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt
politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze
small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense
contractors and pharmaceutical companies.

Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take
back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52575?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]ELECT LUCAS KUNCE

Let’s just be clear here: Hawley’s January 6th cowardice isn’t the only
reason he’s incapable of representing my home state.

Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even
$0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money
for himself.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52575?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]Business Insider excerpt about Hawley's profits from book sales: The
Missouri senator's annual financial disclosure, filed last week, indicated
that he made $127,500 from book royalties in 2023. It is unclear whether
that sum includes an advance for Hawley's forthcoming book or also
includes composed of royalties from the senator's previous books. In 2021,
Hawley made $467,000 in book royalties. Headlines from KC Star and
Missourinet about Hawley's refusal to invest in Missouri.

While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up
prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of
thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his
weird book all about "Manhood."

All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52575?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]St. Louis Post-Dispatch headline: MO taxpayers paid more than $250,000
for Josh Hawley's open records violations.

Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the
Senate, Peter , and voters of
all stripes seem to agree.

Morning Consult reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating
of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November. And even
Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator
Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was “the worst decision I’ve ever
made in my life.”

After spending a whole year consolidating support from workers, community
leaders, and organizations across Missouri, Lucas Kunce has more than
proved that he has what it takes to win this race. Multiple polls even
confirm he’s in a dead heat with Hawley. That’s why I’m asking for your
help, Peter:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52575?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]Will you join me in supporting my friend Lucas Kunce by chipping in
$10 or more today? With so much at stake in this election —
and with a race this close — no one can afford to sit on the sidelines.

If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your
contribution instantly:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52576?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=1007&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]Contribute $10
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52576?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=1008&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]Contribute $25
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52575?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1009&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]Give another amount

Lucas won’t be another shady, corrupt politician. He’s put his money where
his mouth is since day one — refusing to accept any money from corporate
PACs, federal lobbyists, or Big Oil and Big Pharma executives.

He’s running to be a real warrior for working Missourians, unbeholden to
anyone other than the everyday people who elected him to office.

Lucas will fight for investment in our state — rebuilding forgotten
communities, creating jobs, and empowering workers. He’ll stand up to the
attacks on reproductive rights by controlling politicians like Hawley.
He’ll work to end the corporate grip on power in our country, by banning
insider trading and abolishing corporate PACs. And he’ll be accountable to
real, everyday Missourians.

I can’t tell you how excited I am about everything we’ll be able to
accomplish in Missouri with Lucas fighting for us in the
Senate, Peter. But if we’re
going to take advantage of this historic opportunity, Lucas urgently needs
your help.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52575?refcode=em20240615-5769&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1010&akid=5769%2E614464%2Eoa4XXG ]So please, will you chip in $10 right now so we can get
Lucas’ unifying message in front of voters, defeat Josh Hawley, and flip
Missouri’s Senate seat this year? Lucas is running a truly grassroots
campaign, so anything you’re able to give really does make a big impact.

And thank you to _all_ of our supporters for reading and sharing my human rights advocacy. Here's your June 9-15 recap of _Let 's Address This_ with Qasim Rashid.

Teen: I'm so sick of doing math on Khan Academy
Me: Then why not do some yard work and make it Lawn Academy?
Wife: Or maybe study at sunrise and make it Dawn Academy?
Me: Or try and sooth your muscles and make it Balm Academy?
Teen: I immediately regret my decision
Me: Or raise a baby deer and make it Fawn Academy?
Wife: Or study ocean shrimp and make it Prawn Academy
Teen: ... I'm gonna get back to my math
Me: Good idea :)
* *Note: No teenagers were harmed in the making of this dad joke

# I'm Fighting to End Our Pedestrian Safety Crisis
---
Recently released analysis from Smart Growth America has again confirmed that pedestrian fatalities have risen to levels greatly out of proportion to Indy's population.
[I talked to Fox59](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDYsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vZm94NTkuY29tL25ld3MvcmF0ZS1vZi1pbmRpYW5hLXBlZGVzdHJpYW5zLWtpbGxlZC1ieS1jYXJzLWNvbnRpbnVlcy10by1jbGltYi8_ZmJjbGlkPUl3WlhoMGJnTmhaVzBDTVRBQUFSMExMQ05XUl9HTEppSU5WQXBIYkZlMFhILUdWTEhiamxBSW5zNXl5T1JhZ3I1Q3pSbFRGS2Ffc1U4X2FlbV9abUZyWldSMWJXMTVNVFppZVhSbGN3IiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDYxNS45NjMxNDIwMSJ9.s2Ov02UQf7jPMaxal80Jysd_2fPxzCugUDmZNT2ZxnQ/s/2950175210/br/244264077116-l) about the growing street safety crisis. Indy needs dedicated resources to rethink outdated design choices that encourage dangerous driving and force pedestrians and cars to compete for space.
Reducing pedestrian injuries and fatalities to zero means starting somewhere, and starting as soon as possible. We must do more and we must do better.

Neighbors, thank you for contacting me about the ongoing issues at AES. All Hoosiers rely on our utility companies to provide efficient and transparent service, and I share your concerns about the implementation of their new billing software. The IURC is holding a public meeting with AES officials on **Monday, June 17 at 2PM in Room 222 of the PNC Center (across from the Statehouse)** to discuss ongoing issues with their new billing. It will also be open for folks to attend and [watch online at this link](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDgsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmluLmdvdi9pdXJjL3dhdGNoLXRoZS1pdXJjLWxpdmUvIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDYxNS45NjMxNDIwMSJ9.FJ13R3pmErqXjO9geULbnJrMZjJVZLkEsznS_ddJOS8/s/2950175210/br/244264077116-l). ## STORIES SHAPING OUR STATE
[Learn More about Vision Zero and What it Could Mean for Indy](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..sseO1VlITFTLk5mDqKqytfn2n4sXwmcM8WcCEsoo6Is/s/2950175210/br/244264077116-l)
I've fought for a Vision Zero plan since my first legislative Session and I don't plan to quit fighting any time soon. This report from IndyStar dives into the work being done and the impact Vision Zero could have for Indianapolis. Other cities have made common sense choices to bring traffic incident injuries & fatalities down, and so can we.
[ReThink I-65/I-70 Coalition Seeking Public Feedback](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..cnDZc9KhSpdT9HIP_FaSyfgogl6529YkkaJ67nDfors/s/2950175210/br/244264077116-l)
For over 50 years, interstate highways have divided many downtown neighborhoods instead of connecting them. What could Indy's next 50 years could look like if we centered these communities instead? Learn more at [rethink65-70.org](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTEsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vbC5mYWNlYm9vay5jb20vbC5waHA_.Y1UWjVLpylPnewilwwTsQnPYzxrUtdd-x_HgUTn5mkM/s/2950175210/br/244264077116-l) & share your thoughts on their proposal at [propelindy.com.](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTIsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHA6Ly9wcm9wZWxpbmR5LmNvbS8_ZmJjbGlkPUl3WlhoMGJnTmhaVzBDTVRBQUFSMGJyQXZYSXl1Q0syd0ZqdE9KaG5xaEg2eEFrNzN3NmQ4NjFLXzFITHhyZE9qOU8wbHhIaWxDQzRjX2FlbV9abUZyWldSMWJXMTVNVFppZVhSbGN3IiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDYxNS45NjMxNDIwMSJ9.w6lASe5cX510UKRln5VU7Wbp8CPyucdLBOa5BrQpHxA/s/2950175210/br/244264077116-l) Submissions close June 30th.
[June is LGBTQ+ Pride Month!](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTMsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lmluc3RhZ3JhbS5jb20vcC9DNzl0MERodTRXby8_aW1nX2luZGV4PTQiLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwNjE1Ljk2MzE0MjAxIn0.GnODAlvnJB3DiFjo4ejCE1nVP5KVqZHfYSI7Ndw7urE/s/2950175210/br/244264077116-l)
I had so much fun celebrating Pride with you last weekend, Indy! I support and defend LGBTQ+ Hoosiers, and I always will. Thank you for making our city and state a place we can all be proud of.

name: Joe Pereles for Missouri
subject: Stop extremists from banning IVF
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pereles for Missouri, Rhonda West, Treasurer
body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
If you think the basic right to have autonomy over your reproductive health care decisions is increasingly at risk due to the overturning of Roe v. Wade, wait—there is more. And it gets even worse, if that is possible.
When Roe was overturned by the Supreme Court in 2022, abortions were completely banned in Missouri with vague exceptions to “save the life of the mother.” But this denial of personal choice is only the beginning.
Now Republicans are brazenly preparing to limit or eliminate access to contraception and in-vitro fertilization (IVF). These threats have nothing to do with the real needs of Missourians, but simply fall in line with a national MAGA agenda to take away personal freedom and maximize government control over personal choices. We saw the fallout from a judicial decision in Alabama that forbids access to IVF. There is nothing to stop this from happening here.
Our own U.S. Senators have already begun undermining such freedoms. Senators Josh Hawley and Eric Schmitt, both Republicans who claim to be pro-family and in favor of limited government, voted against a bill that would ensure a right to contraceptives for anyone who wants or needs it.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=ivf [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=ivf]
I believe that we must safeguard reproductive rights and protect our fundamental right to privacy. Every individual should have control over their own lives and bodies, and the right to plan if, when, or how to start a family.
Reckless extremists with radical and unpopular views about contraception and IVF have no place making laws that cause chaos, uncertainty, and emotional turmoil for women and families.
The lack of action by the Missouri legislature and the failure by our GOP Senators to enshrine protections for contraception access is alarming. As your State Senator, I will fight to protect IVF and guarantee access to fertility treatment.
Winning this seat is crucial to putting an end to the chaos and extremism that endangers basic reproductive rights and puts lives at risk. We can do more than just stop bad legislation if we flip this seat: we can take proactive steps to protect access to IVF and contraception.
Can I count on you to support this campaign and help me stand up for our rights in Jefferson City? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=ivf]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=ivf]
Thank you for never giving up the fight for our basic freedoms and rights. There is so much at stake, and I know that we will win together.
Sincerely,
Joe

name: Jane Fonda
subject: I’m teaming up with the Terminator.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC,[janepac
body:
Big Oil doesn’t stand a chance.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86960099/479569411/1328794144?refcode=ea.fb3e6fd0-2d2b-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.fb3e6fd0-2d2b-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZiM2U2ZmQwLTJkMmItZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VL-sXwh5rzd19XOmkPDD0p7R3bRXjj4dTvvauPVahRk=&emci=927c4263-832a-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=fb3e6fd0-2d2b-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)
---
It's not every day you hear "Arnold Schwarzenegger and Jane Fonda" in the same sentence. But Arnold and I go way back, and we have a lot in common. Before I explain, I have a really quick favor to ask: **[Can you chip in to help Jane PAC close our end-of-quarter fundraising gap before June 30th? Every gift powers our work to elect climate champions, so it’d mean a lot to me if you could spare even $3 or $5 for our cause. (thank you)](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86960100/479569412/2105508926?amount=3&refcode=ea.fb3e6fd0-2d2b-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.fb3e6fd0-2d2b-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZiM2U2ZmQwLTJkMmItZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VL-sXwh5rzd19XOmkPDD0p7R3bRXjj4dTvvauPVahRk=)** Rewind to the 80s, and you'll find Arnold and me at the heart of the original fitness craze. Remember those neon leg warmers, VHS workout tapes, and aerobics classes? We were the original fitness influencers before social media was even a twinkle in the internet's eye. And then, of course, there's politics. Arnold was the last Republican governor elected in California, while I’ve been a lifelong progressive activist. On the surface, we might seem like an odd pair, but when it comes to fighting Big Oil, we’ve found common ground. **This year, we're teaming up to defeat a dangerous Big Oil power grab in California.** Back in March, Arnold joined me and Governor Newsom at an event near Inglewood Oil Field to oppose Big Oil’s deceptive campaign to overturn California’s crucial 2022 law that banned oil wells within 3,200 feet of our schools, hospitals, and other vulnerable safety areas. During an interview that day, Arnold joked that I’ve been bossing him around since the 70s, but it didn't take any convincing to get him to show up for a fight we both care deeply about — protecting our planet from out-of-control oil drilling. That’s because he knows this is about more than partisan politics. This is about protecting our children’s health, our communities, and our future. This issue affects all of us — whether you’re a Republican or Democrat, a movie star or a movie fan, a Californian or a Floridian. clean_body: Big Oil doesn’t stand a chance. | It's not every day you hear "Arnold Schwarzenegger and Jane Fonda" in the same sentence. But Arnold and I go way back, and we have a lot in common. Before I explain, I have a really quick favor to ask: = Rewind to the 80s, and you'll find Arnold and me at the heart of the original fitness craze. Remember those neon leg warmers, VHS workout tapes, and aerobics classes? We were the original fitness influencers before social media was even a twinkle in the internet's eye. And then, of course, there's politics. Arnold was the last Republican governor elected in California, while I’ve been a lifelong progressive activist. On the surface, we might seem like an odd pair, but when it comes to fighting Big Oil, we’ve found common ground. This year, we're teaming up to defeat a dangerous Big Oil power grab in California. Back in March, Arnold joined me and Governor Newsom at an event near Inglewood Oil Field to oppose Big Oil’s deceptive campaign to overturn California’s crucial 2022 law that banned oil wells within 3,200 feet of our schools, hospitals, and other vulnerable safety areas. During an interview that day, Arnold joked that I’ve been bossing him around since the 70s, but it didn't take any convincing to get him to show up for a fight we both care deeply about — protecting our planet from out-of-control oil drilling. That’s because he knows this is about more than partisan politics. This is about protecting our children’s health, our communities, and our future. This issue affects all of us — whether you’re a Republican or Democrat, a movie star or a movie fan, a Californian or a Floridian. It's about coming together for a cause that transcends our differences and unites us around a common goal: derailing the fossil fuel industry’s greedy agenda and protecting our environment from the harms of oil drilling. body:
We need a massive overhaul of our political system.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240615-1&t=1&akid=814%2E587540%2EHdjhUu)
I’ve got something on my mind today, Peter, but first I’ll get right to the point:
**[Our mid-month deadline is coming up this weekend and we NEED to raise $10,000 to meet our online fundraising goal. So, can I count on your $5 donation to make sure we can keep electing young leaders across the country?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240615-1?refcode=em20240615-1&amount=5&refcode2=814_587540_HdjhUu&akid=814%2E587540%2EHdjhUu)**
***Just so you know, we are behind on small dollar fundraising projections this quarter because Google/Gmail changed their email algorithm (without telling us) so a ton of our emails were being sent to people's spam instead of their actual inbox. We’re finally fixing it, but this means we do need to catch up.***
We only started Leaders We Deserve last year, and we’ve already made an impact.
Just look at the Virginia elections last year when we elected Nadarius Clark, now serving as the youngest member of the Virginia Assembly. He went on to cast the deciding vote that killed a Republican bill that would allow the arming of teachers.
More recently, we helped Molly Cook win a special election _AND_ a primary runoff in Houston BY ONLY 74 VOTES!!!! (A little too close for comfort but that means we spent the perfect amount of money and no more.) AND that means we elected the youngest, most progressive, and first openly LGBTQ+ member of the Texas Senate **_– and it’s not even November yet! (It’s pretty awesome 😊)_**
These early victories are truly incredible, especially because we founded this organization knowing we were playing the long game. The way I see it, the work we’re doing at Leaders We Deserve is a 30-year chess game inspired by how conservatives took over the country. **It will take time, but we can take it back.**
Peter, I am fully confident one of our endorsed candidates in the next cycle or two will be President by 2050. We are electing the next generation of leaders at every level who have the potential to change the course of American history.
**We’re electing young leaders who can create a society free from gun violence, where school shootings are left in our history books and not in our headlines. And a country where threats like climate change are met with action and not paralysis.**
I can’t thank this team enough for the essential role you play in this work. Our mission is not just about helping young people claim their power, it’s about laying the groundwork for the massive overhaul our political system desperately needs.
**[If you’re with us in the fight, can you rush in $5 now before our deadline at 11:59 PM Sunday night? Any donation, large or small, makes a difference.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240615-1?refcode=em20240615-1&amount=5&refcode2=814_587540_HdjhUu&akid=814%2E587540%2EHdjhUu)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

INSIDER NEWS FROM THE FRONTLINES OF THE POLITICAL REVOLUTION

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: Fight for the Future Town Hall | Bowman vs. AIPAC | Vermont’s
Big Win vs. Big Oil | NEW Endorsements in NY, CO | Bernie: End Polluter
Welfare | Worker Organizing with NLRB | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

AIPAC and Trump donors are spending $25 million trying to unseat
Congressman Jamaal Bowman — a champion for peace, climate, reproductive
rights, and racial justice.

Hillary Clinton just joined them in supporting his opponent, a corporate
Dem taking money from anti-abortion Republicans who oppose Biden’s agenda
to tax the rich.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18206?t=1011&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]Pitch in whatever you can so we can ramp up our GOTV operation for
Bowman as early voting starts today!

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

Not only is our democracy on the line but so is the fate of our planet. We
have to fight back against the big money trying to buy our elections and
buy policy that enriches Big Oil at our expense.

That’s why Our Revolution hosted our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18297?t=1012&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]Fight for the Future Town Hall on
Monday with U.S. Rep. Jamaal Bowman, Vermont Lt. Gov. David Zuckerman,
Vermont Rep. Emilie Krasnow, and Rev. Lennox Yearwood Jr. of the Hip Hop
Caucus.

Our movement is mobilizing to re-elect these powerhouse climate champions
and organize for the next phase of the climate fight. To do that, we have
to out-organize the Big Money flooding Democratic primaries from
right-wing billionaires, corporate cronies, AIPAC, and MAGA donors.

★ ★ ★

Early voting starts TODAY in New York, and Our Revolution is part of a
progressive coalition hitting the streets and the phones for Jamaal Bowman
in this final stretch to Election Day June 25th.

Up to $25 MILLION is pouring into the NY-16 primary in a coordinated
effort to try to replace Bowman with a corporate Democrat, who has become
the largest recipient of AIPAC money so far this election cycle.

“They dropped another million on their ads,” [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18298?t=1013&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]Bowman said at our Town
Hall Monday. “They’re spending an astronomical amount simply because we’re
fighting for peace and justice, equality and humanity, and especially
because we called for a permanent ceasefire in Gaza.”

Bowman is also under assault from MAGA money — “the same money that goes
to fighting abortion rights from women, voting rights, climate action,” he
told us. “They don’t want a working-class person in this seat, they want
someone who will bend the knee to Big Money in politics — which we’ll
never, ever do because that’s what’s accelerating the destruction of our
democracy.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18005?t=1014&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ][IMG]

Like Jamaal said, “Organized people beat organized money every time.” If
you’re near NYC, we need you to join us in knocking on doors during this
final stretch! Bernie and AOC will also be coming in for a rally.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18005?t=1015&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]All hands on deck! Sign up here to GOTV with fellow progressives for
Jamaal Bowman.

★ ★ ★

It may be David vs Goliath, but Our Revolution candidates in Vermont just
won a major victory against the fossil fuel industry — one we hope to see
replicated in state after state!

The historic legislation requires oil and gas companies to pay for the
climate damage they cause. “If you make a mess, clean it up,” VT Rep.
Emilie Krasnow said on our Fight for the Future Town Hall.

A barrage of climate catastrophes, including torrential flooding caused
billions in damage last year and was a “real wake-up call for many,” she
said. “Even our Republican Governor agrees that the burden should not rest
on the taxpayers — on working Vermonters, small businesses, farmers.”

Vermont Lt. Gov. David Zuckerman told us he and Emilie will keep pushing
for legislation to transition the state’s biggest power companies to 100%
renewable energy, which the Governor vetoed this round.

Zuckerman has worked with Bernie for decades, so he knows uphill battles
that can be won. He’s also a lifelong farmer who has experienced the
devastation of climate events firsthand and seen people come together in
times of environmental crisis.

“We can’t let them pit us against each other,” David told us. “Climate
affects all of us. When we unite, we are more powerful than the corporate
powers. We just have to see it.”

Early voting for the Vermont primary starts in just 2 weeks and runs
through Aug. 13th, when Emilie, David, and Bernie Sanders will all be on
the ballot for re-election.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16898?t=1016&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]Donate any amount to make sure Our Revolution maxes out our GOTV work
to re-elect Bernie and climate champs like Emilie Krasnow, and David
Zuckerman in Vermont!

★ ★ ★

Speaking of Bernie — while Donald Trump is begging Big Oil for a billion
dollars to help get him back in the White House, our coalition for climate
is taking the fight against fossil fuels to the next level.

Sen. Bernie Sanders and U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar recently introduced the End
Polluter Welfare Act in Congress to end tax loopholes and taxpayer
handouts to the fossil fuel industry.

It’s time to demand our politicians stop using OUR MONEY to pay oil and
gas companies to kill us. We must break their deadly business model, and
forge a path to a clean energy paradigm — now before it’s too late.

Rev. Lennox Yearwood Jr., President of the Hip Hop Caucus, inspired us all
on the Fight for the Future Town Hall as he called for us to break out of
our siloes and reach folks with a clear, unifying message:

“We’re on the brink. We must stop using our tax dollars to fund the
madness of our extinction. As human beings, we must say, ‘No, we will not
fund our destruction anymore,” Rev. Yearwood said.

“The Trump tax breaks expire in 2025, so this is an opportunity, a
critical moment in history,” he urged. “This is not a partisan issue, I
don’t know anybody who wants to pay someone to poison their child.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16898?t=1017&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]Every dollar you donate to Our Revolution helps us mobilize the
grassroots to support crucial legislation like Bernie’s bill to End
Polluter Welfare. Chip in today!

★ ★ ★

NEW ENDORSEMENTS!

In addition to Jamaal Bowman in New York, Our Revolution is also
supporting FIVE progressives for state assembly seats — this is how we
build out the legislature with champions for climate, healthcare, housing,
wages, and justice.

If you’re in New York state or know someone who is, let folks know about
these powerhouse progressive champs on the ballot: Sarahana Shrestha
(AD-103), Claire Cousin (AD-106), Jessica Gonzalez-Rojas (AD-34), Eon
Tyrell Huntley (AD-56), and Gabriella Romero (AD-109).

★ ★ ★

Our Revolution is excited to endorse NINE progressives for the Colorado
Legislature!

For State House we’re backing: Tim Hernandez (HD-4), Junie Joseph (HD-10),
Kyra deGruy Kennedy (HD-30), Manny Rutinel (HD-32), Bryan Lindstrom
(HD-36), Sarah McKeen (HD-51), Yara Zokaie (HD-52), and Andrew Boesenecker
(HD-53).

And, we are supporting Mike Weissman for State Senate (District 28). The
Colorado primary is June 25th and early voting starts this Tuesday (June
17th)!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16898?t=1018&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]Please chip in any amount to power our voter turnout operations across
the country in 2024. As we battle Trump and the far right, we must invest
in defending AND expanding progressive power up and down the ballot.

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

On Tuesday, we joined a LIVE event on Worker Organizing with the Economic
Policy Institute and discussed new developments at the National Labor
Relations Board.

NLRB General Counsel Jennifer Abruzzo gave us a breakdown of all the major
reforms her office has undertaken. And, Our Revolution Chair Larry Cohen -
former President of the Communications Workers of America - joined her on
a panel to talk about the impact on workplace organizing.

The NLRB has taken great measures to support worker organizing and
bargaining rights under the Biden administration, and we got to hear from
Cindy Estrada, Strategic Advisor to the President of the Center for
Transformational Organizing, AFL-CIO.

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

Jamaal Bowman is not the only one under serious attack. Right-wing
billionaires, corporate cronies, AIPAC, and MAGA donors are pouring
millions into Democratic primaries trying to unseat some of our top
progressive champions in Congress.

We refuse to let powerful voices like Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Cori
Bush, Pramila Jayapal, and others be silenced by the donor class. Even
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18299?t=1019&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]Politico is highlighting the scourge of Republican money being dumped
into Democratic primaries.

Our Revolution and the grassroots progressive movement are mobilizing in
districts across the country right now to out-organize the Big Money. This
means speaking directly to voters through phone banks, online outreach,
and knocking on doors.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16898?t=1020&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]DONATE TO HELP US DEFEND AND EXPAND PROGRESSIVE POWER IN CONGRESS IN
2024

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18005?t=1021&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ][IMG]

We heard from Congressman Jamaal Bowman on our call Monday about how he is
under attack by AIPAC and MAGA in his run for re-election in NY-16 — but
people power can beat big money in this race.

We hope you’ll sign up to hit the streets as part of our GOTV operation,
led by Our Revolution Volunteer Organizer Joe Lawrence.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18005?t=1022&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]CLICK HERE TO GOTV FOR JAMAAL BOWMAN

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18006?t=1023&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ][IMG]

At this moment, we must carry the message of peace in any way we can.
Every purchase from our merch store helps fund our movement. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18006?t=1024&akid=6182%2E5885482%2E1DKyPf ]Check it
out here!

Up to $25 MILLION is pouring into the NY-16 primary in a coordinated effort to try to replace Bowman with a corporate Democrat, who has become the largest recipient of AIPAC money so far this election cycle. “They dropped another million on their ads,” [ ]Bowman said at our Town Hall Monday. “They’re spending an astronomical amount simply because we’re fighting for peace and justice, equality and humanity, and especially because we called for a permanent ceasefire in Gaza.” Bowman is also under assault from MAGA money — “the same money that goes to fighting abortion rights from women, voting rights, climate action,” he told us. “They don’t want a working-class person in this seat, they want someone who will bend the knee to Big Money in politics — which we’ll never, ever do because that’s what’s accelerating the destruction of our democracy.” [ ][IMG] Like Jamaal said, “Organized people beat organized money every time.” If you’re near NYC, we need you to join us in knocking on doors during this final stretch! Bernie and AOC will also be coming in for a rally. [ ]All hands on deck! Sign up here to GOTV with fellow progressives for Jamaal Bowman. ★ ★ ★ It may be David vs Goliath, but Our Revolution candidates in Vermont just won a major victory against the fossil fuel industry — one we hope to see replicated in state after state! The historic legislation requires oil and gas companies to pay for the climate damage they cause. “If you make a mess, clean it up,” VT Rep. Emilie Krasnow said on our Fight for the Future Town Hall. A barrage of climate catastrophes, including torrential flooding caused billions in damage last year and was a “real wake-up call for many,” she said. “Even our Republican Governor agrees that the burden should not rest on the taxpayers — on working Vermonters, small businesses, farmers.” Vermont Lt. Gov. David Zuckerman told us he and Emilie will keep pushing for legislation to transition the state’s biggest power companies to 100% renewable energy, which the Governor vetoed this round. Zuckerman has worked with Bernie for decades, so he knows uphill battles that can be won. He’s also a lifelong farmer who has experienced the devastation of climate events firsthand and seen people come together in times of environmental crisis. “We can’t let them pit us against each other,” David told us. “Climate affects all of us. When we unite, we are more powerful than the corporate powers. We just have to see it.” Early voting for the Vermont primary starts in just 2 weeks and runs through Aug. 13th, when Emilie, David, and Bernie Sanders will all be on the ballot for re-election. [ ]Donate any amount to make sure Our Revolution maxes out our GOTV work to re-elect Bernie and climate champs like Emilie Krasnow, and David Zuckerman in Vermont! ★ ★ ★ Speaking of Bernie — while Donald Trump is begging Big Oil for a billion dollars to help get him back in the White House, our coalition for climate is taking the fight against fossil fuels to the next level. Sen. Bernie Sanders and U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar recently introduced the End Polluter Welfare Act in Congress to end tax loopholes and taxpayer handouts to the fossil fuel industry. It’s time to demand our politicians stop using OUR MONEY to pay oil and gas companies to kill us. We must break their deadly business model, and forge a path to a clean energy paradigm — now before it’s too late. Rev. Lennox Yearwood Jr., President of the Hip Hop Caucus, inspired us all on the Fight for the Future Town Hall as he called for us to break out of our siloes and reach folks with a clear, unifying message: “We’re on the brink. We must stop using our tax dollars to fund the madness of our extinction. As human beings, we must say, ‘No, we will not fund our destruction anymore,” Rev. Yearwood said. “The Trump tax breaks expire in 2025, so this is an opportunity, a critical moment in history,” he urged. “This is not a partisan issue, I don’t know anybody who wants to pay someone to poison their child.” [ ]Every dollar you donate to Our Revolution helps us mobilize the grassroots to support crucial legislation like Bernie’s bill to End Polluter Welfare. Chip in today! ★ ★ ★ NEW ENDORSEMENTS! In addition to Jamaal Bowman in New York, Our Revolution is also supporting FIVE progressives for state assembly seats — this is how we build out the legislature with champions for climate, healthcare, housing, wages, and justice. If you’re in New York state or know someone who is, let folks know about these powerhouse progressive champs on the ballot: Sarahana Shrestha (AD-103), Claire Cousin (AD-106), Jessica Gonzalez-Rojas (AD-34), Eon Tyrell Huntley (AD-56), and Gabriella Romero (AD-109). ★ ★ ★ Our Revolution is excited to endorse NINE progressives for the Colorado Legislature! For State House we’re backing: Tim Hernandez (HD-4), Junie Joseph (HD-10), Kyra deGruy Kennedy (HD-30), Manny Rutinel (HD-32), Bryan Lindstrom (HD-36), Sarah McKeen (HD-51), Yara Zokaie (HD-52), and Andrew Boesenecker (HD-53). And, we are supporting Mike Weissman for State Senate (District 28). The Colorado primary is June 25th and early voting starts this Tuesday (June 17th)! [ ]Please chip in any amount to power our voter turnout operations across the country in 2024. As we battle Trump and the far right, we must invest in defending AND expanding progressive power up and down the ballot. ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ On Tuesday, we joined a LIVE event on Worker Organizing with the Economic Policy Institute and discussed new developments at the National Labor Relations Board. NLRB General Counsel Jennifer Abruzzo gave us a breakdown of all the major reforms her office has undertaken. And, Our Revolution Chair Larry Cohen - former President of the Communications Workers of America - joined her on a panel to talk about the impact on workplace organizing. The NLRB has taken great measures to support worker organizing and bargaining rights under the Biden administration, and we got to hear from Cindy Estrada, Strategic Advisor to the President of the Center for Transformational Organizing, AFL-CIO. ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ Jamaal Bowman is not the only one under serious attack. Right-wing billionaires, corporate cronies, AIPAC, and MAGA donors are pouring millions into Democratic primaries trying to unseat some of our top progressive champions in Congress. We refuse to let powerful voices like Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Cori Bush, Pramila Jayapal, and others be silenced by the donor class. Even [ ]Politico is highlighting the scourge of Republican money being dumped into Democratic primaries. Our Revolution and the grassroots progressive movement are mobilizing in districts across the country right now to out-organize the Big Money. This means speaking directly to voters through phone banks, online outreach, and knocking on doors. We hope you’ll sign up to hit the streets as part of our GOTV operation, led by Our Revolution Volunteer Organizer Joe Lawrence. | Hi friend — Here’s something you may not know about me: **I’m gay.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70315?t=6&akid=15135%2E878179%2Ey2SLDE) Pride Month is a time when we are supposed to be celebrating the countless qualities that make people beautifully different.

But this year, it’s tough to celebrate when extremist Republicans are doubling down on their hateful bills to target LGBTQ+ people like me.

They’re banning gender-affirming care for trans kids.

They’re targeting drag shows.

They’re silencing discussions about pronouns and LGBTQ+ history in schools.

They’re allowing religious entities to discriminate against LGBTQ+ people.

They’re forcing trans people to use bathrooms that don’t correspond to their gender identity...**and so much more.

**The recent uptick in anti-LGBTQ+ bills is not only heartbreaking; but also illustrates how long of a way we have to go to secure equal rights and protections for LGBTQ+ folks like me. And that starts with voting out every single homophobic, bigoted Republican at the ballot box.**

[The Voter Protection Project is dedicated to replacing these same Republicans with Democrats who are dedicated to guaranteeing equality for _all_ LGBTQ+ people. If you support our mission, will you chip in anything you can in honor of Pride Month to help us continue our work? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70315?t=7&akid=15135%2E878179%2Ey2SLDE)** | [CONTRIBUTE $7 NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70315?t=8&akid=15135%2E878179%2Ey2SLDE)

_But they’ll suppress the right to vote to ensure they can stay in power so they can keep fueling their anti-LGBTQ+ agenda._

I’m fed up with watching folks in my community be targeted, silenced, and attacked for choosing to live as their authentic selves.

[If you are too, will contribute to the Voter Protection Project today? Every dollar donated to this email will go towards combating Republicans’ attacks on the ballot box while electing Democrats who will push for LGBTQ+ protections. »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70315?t=9&akid=15135%2E878179%2Ey2SLDE)

Dear
Friend,

While we
see it most often among young people, a socialist way of thinking
is spreading broadly across the U.S. and around the world.

It is
critical to keep the facts, history, and results of both
Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism at the forefront of the
national conversation.

That's
why I'm sending you this email today. I would like to personally
invite you to watch the new Hoover Institution video lecture,
Socialism vs. Capitalism for free.

You can
sign up for this four-chapter lecture here:
https://resources.hoover.org/socialism-vs-capitalism-course-signup/

This
lecture is from Hoover's exclusive Policy Bootcamp and is led by
Peter Berkowitz-a Senior Fellow at Hoover who served in teh
previous administration as U.S. State Department Director of
Policy Planning.

Peter is
an academic expert on political philosophy, ranging from
constitutional conservatism to progressivism. Inside this lecture
he'll give you a deeper understanding of:

Distinctions between capitalism and socialism

Common criticisms of both economic systems

Disagreement between Karl Marx and John Locke regarding property
rights

Centralized economic planning and its failures

You
can activate your free online lecture right now by using this
secure link:
https://resources.hoover.org/socialism-vs-capitalism-course-signup/

Thank
you,
Greg

body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86967983/479593046/-731719488?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Mzg1ZDJiYi0zODJiLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nbgmC6CQnff6XKsEZpN2MS5hWCldezhBLjdPWuUsBU0=)
Peter,

**[I wanted to take a moment to share more about why I'm running for Congress. I hope you'll read this entire message, then consider making a donation before our end-of-quarter deadline to help us improve lives in CA-27 and beyond.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86967991/479593051/-731719488?refcode=em-6.15.24-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Mzg1ZDJiYi0zODJiLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nbgmC6CQnff6XKsEZpN2MS5hWCldezhBLjdPWuUsBU0=)**

When I think about why I'm running for Congress, I think about my kids -- specifically my daughter, Maya.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86967996/479593058/-731719488?refcode=em-6.15.24-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Mzg1ZDJiYi0zODJiLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nbgmC6CQnff6XKsEZpN2MS5hWCldezhBLjdPWuUsBU0=)
I'll never forget the day six years ago when Maya came home from kindergarten and told me about some “exercises” she’d done with her classmates. She didn't quite understand what was going on, but I realized she was describing an active shooter drill.

It hit me at that moment; we now live in a country where millions of Americans fear that a hug goodbye before school, a concert, or even church, could be the last.

I also think about the Supreme Court's ruling on _Roe v. Wade_. Right now, Maya is on a path to have less control over her body than my wife, or even my mom, did. I never imagined that was possible, and it's completely unacceptable.

**The problem we face is that a major political party in our country is not willing to take common sense steps to save lives. The good news is we have the power to change that; if we can change who represents us in Congress.**

My Republican opponent Mike Garcia co-sponsored a bill that would create a nationwide ban on abortion _without exceptions_. Literally days after the mass shooting in Uvalde, Texas, Garcia was taking cash from a pro-gun group that opposes background checks.

body:
Hey Peter,
If you've seen any emails from my team recently, you know that we have a major FEC deadline coming up at the end of this month.
Before I tell you why this deadline matters so much, will you chip in a few dollars to help power our grassroots campaign? Here's the link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yassaminansari_em](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86969760/479597446/2145040083?refcode=240615_ya_midjune3_l1&ms=240615_ya_midjune3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMDA5NzNiMC0zYTJiLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j2pt0UHav8grzI3aQFAfsnbRUKg3UPLML5EwLh7RGwI=) **
Peter, if it were up to me, running for Congress would be less about fundraising and more about talking to voters. But unfortunately, because of our broken campaign finance system, it's incredibly expensive.
All too often, special interest groups and dark-money super PACs drown out the voices of everyday people, making it really difficult for young candidates to get elected.
When we launched this campaign, we knew it would be a fight. We knew that we'd be going up against the corporate lobbyists, people smearing my name with misinformation, and that establishment well-connected elites would be doing everything they could to keep us out of Congress.
That's why we built such a strong community and we knew we'd succeed or fail based on the strength of our grassroots support.
I knew these challenges and smears were coming but I chose to run anyway because I believe deeply in our vision for this community. I believe that working people deserve a real voice in Congress and that we need a new generation of leaders who will be champions for affordable housing, climate action, and reproductive rights.
With your help, that's the kind of Congresswoman I'll be. If you can chip in a few dollars before our major FEC deadline, it would mean the world to me and everyone on our team.
Here's the link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yassaminansari_em](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86969761/479597447/2145040083?refcode=240615_ya_midjune3_l1&ms=240615_ya_midjune3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMDA5NzNiMC0zYTJiLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j2pt0UHav8grzI3aQFAfsnbRUKg3UPLML5EwLh7RGwI=) **
Thank you so much, Peter.
— Yassamin

Phoenix, AZ 85002
United States

name: Seth Moulton
subject: The path to taking back the House runs through NY-1
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/seth-moulton-3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/seth-moulton-3]
Friend -

When I first ran for office, my mission was simple: to bring a new generation of leaders to Congress.

With our rights and our freedoms under attack, we desperately need new voices and another generation of leaders standing up for us in Congress. We need more Americans answering the call to service. That's why when I see proven leaders who can bring people together and get things done running for office, I'm proud to support them.

My friend John Avlon is running for Congress in New York's First District, and he's exactly the type of person we need more of in the House. He knows that the answer to our problems isn't more partisanship -- it's coming together with common sense and working to find common solutions.

John's in a tough fight, but he's the only Democrat who can win back this seat from the GOP. Will you join me and support John's campaign with a split contribution today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-avlon]

Democrats can't afford to lose this seat. The stakes are just too high.

While Massachusetts remains a safe place for people to seek abortions and other essential reproductive care, millions of Americans are currently being denied the ability to make their own healthcare decisions. And that will continue if the GOP retains control of the House.

Democracy is on the line too, both at home and abroad. Trump and his enablers have cozied up to murderous autocrats and dictators around the world. Nearly all of them still refuse to accept the results of our elections here at home. If the GOP keeps the House, Trump and Vladimir Putin will count it as a massive victory.

Our goal is clear. If we want to defend women's reproductive freedoms, support democracy both here and abroad, and rebuild the middle class, we have to win back the House.

John is the only candidate who can win this seat and help us take back the House. It's why nearly every elected Democrat and town committee in the district as well as several of my colleagues are uniting behind John.

We can win back this seat. We can take back the House. But we can't do it alone. Are you with me? Please pitch in today and let's get to work >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-avlon]

-Seth

[**In a moment, I’m going to ask you to make a donation to my campaign for Congress.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86969973/479598382/1610638071?refcode=em20240615am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=679e96cb-3a2b-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NzllOTZjYi0zYTJiLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5fWdA7tyTH9j4Tn_cqM6d1rEnMRzC2OI0Qdj08pLCys=) **But before I do, please let me explain why your support now is so important if we’re going to win this critical House seat in November.**

We did it all with zero support from national Democrats while also being outspent by Boebert’s campaign and her allies.
How? By driving 24,000 miles in my red pickup truck to every corner of the district, showing up, meeting people where they were, and _listening_ to everyone. We put in the work, and people like you who volunteered, donated, made phone calls, etc... You made it all possible.
With Boebert now having running off scared, things are going to be harder and get even nastier. The Super PACs are going to try to smear me on every TV across the district.
**We can fight back against their lies and win this critical House seat, but I’m counting on your support now to do it. [**If you’re able to, can I count on you to make a donation to my campaign right now – no amount is too small – to help us hit our goal, win this critical House seat, and finally replace Lauren Boebert in Congress with someone who will put a stop to the angertainment circus? I’m grateful for every dollar you can afford to chip in.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86969974/479598383/1610638071?refcode=em20240615am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=679e96cb-3a2b-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NzllOTZjYi0zYTJiLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5fWdA7tyTH9j4Tn_cqM6d1rEnMRzC2OI0Qdj08pLCys=)

Peter, I’m excited to kick off June – also known as Pride Month!

I’m proud to be an openly gay Member of Congress. I’ve boldly stood up for the LGBTQ+ community at every turn – from the Equality Act, to trans youth, and even LGBTQ+ servicemembers.

**Today, I want to tell you a bit about my journey as a gay man.**

_I came of age in the 80s_ , during the AIDS crisis – which exacerbated stigmas around queer folks. It was a dark time for the LGBTQ+ community.

When I ran for Congress in the 90s,_I was publicly outed against my will by Republican Ken Calvert._ I lost that race and didn’t get elected to Congress until 2012.

When I was finally elected, I was the _**first** _gay person of color elected to Congress. Since then, our numbers have increased. And the LGBTQ+ community has come so far – including legalizing same-sex marriage in 2015.

But right now, all our progress is at stake. Far-right Republicans are determined to push through a fundamentalist Christian nationalist agenda – _**banning books, abortion, and LGBTQ+ rights.**_

Listen, folks: This campaign isn’t about me. _And it never will be._ This campaign is about _all of us._ It’s about OUR future together. That’s why I feel so fortunate to be out on the campaign trail meeting supporters like you all across the country. I’ve met some really incredible people over the past year, and I wanted to share those experiences with you. In North Carolina, I sat down with Eric and his sons, Christian and Carter. Over burgers and fries, I got to hear all about Eric’s path to becoming a teacher and Carter and Christian’s basketball teams and extracurriculars. Eric shared with me how student loan relief has changed all of their lives for the better. It meant so much to me to hear that. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt0n_-PX9mL8yHKUav8QI_t1nqBov96CDdx3RRuXroiZEZ_yonP0FFXAef5KY2duyhMQXQqMTJ0r8vj4pnUkclJegqNRxi97-sZMUGuO4yTdJL15Pu4zp9NIy482_yYRMc18_LmxELVyTYI2qa7t3Xoos-zJr5iPdaBfmBPGha_DSOwGPPN7BQ35Ekh021oao676AlMLqhk1bx8n_wv0gWs00YaKPcYyd0hC1HED2Dbi4TNLNJGWDZ9NBb8_Y06C4yEg0fJc2_KQH4soLWQAd2GXBRc1PaL4VKd55zWCS_n6ffbWC3Ttuu9SqdZ1C71L7XDQ3UVS0C6PP97GpVEvReaILUEw5CTujotoPgVEQwrwL8asDHYrReejFNb_ytBZeFi7wY8TXXMrKiapStWjokf/478/o3WF5yI-SP-A4IeVK4raSw/h0/h001.nYLT31_bjsK8at9rY60isB4NlNo39sj44I3RBbiOoB8) I met Harry and his mom at one of my campaign rallies in Milwaukee. I’ve struggled with a stutter all my life. Harry told me he experiences the same thing. I told him he can’t let it get in the way of achieving his dreams. And I know he won’t. I’m so proud of him. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt0n_-PX9mL8yHKUav8QI_t1nqBov96CDdx3RRuXroiZEZ_yonP0FFXAef5KY2duyhMQXQqMTJ0r8vj4pnUkclJegqNRxi97-sZMUGuO4yTdCRxwCtVMrUjdjNUUrGGEqhNCyvxphh75BHNEhdenhagm4WXw9BeRTePtJtxOryG1EGBSMzxY-p7cKZlm9RamfO8DBtpmoCWruZ_ivSJL-3iT2UTWv64q3IkPOEmkJZUd8N-KnEQgTisuVR_Vhy67aiFfPX1Mcll0drALx5z6de5hMHgESnEzEx5C6D4uzNHypAcckJB7AqX1E47rt_bYnKG_ENzIzBlqyVQffX467lUdZ1gUqGFYyIIZtt9crWc7iGlGjAQW7a9rpjcP0ayHuJKoXkq9L9SoOAu7qjGGv65/478/o3WF5yI-SP-A4IeVK4raSw/h1/h001.lLo6kwEuZZrkAO5afH7zfgzVcJpol1iSl3h9ExuJ5KY) Jill and I got to sit down with the Cunicelli family in Delaware County, Pennsylvania. Over pizza made by their family’s small business, we talked about the importance of family and gratitude. They were so generous, giving us a tour of their home and garden and a card their daughter, Stella, made with her classmates. I was honored to share a meal with them. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt0n_-PX9mL8yHKUav8QI_t1nqBov96CDdx3RRuXroiZEZ_yonP0FFXAef5KY2duyhMQXQqMTJ0r8vj4pnUkclJegqNRxi97-sZMUGuO4yTdDf--JVZN0uf-6EwVhRbWSmw-GZnH7rmKd8iLS3KnHtsQMgCszrRXZhDmLtlFYPXSdF0Fxif5yL5dwYI-5IwLvZiySkrf98C9yLH1EB4JGsWAxDLqWvspzr3E0tDi6YgycbWF1vaak7yRrvePXjh1N8XiFdKTQAlJw4bYCT9HfKaCyMcWRAAjPBOH8QpeYH-w1EL31PO-MZc0mAE16UECQTx8Jfm0avLaqf2bskaoluyKT-3tJhPDjJcZlk9vr5NI3XnBEzcI6vfpC3eY6lKpurWVrWIMeiTJAZ9mRfwpjkU/478/o3WF5yI-SP-A4IeVK4raSw/h2/h001.G8g9DGZdCJOoI2YKXFNwBpsVVsQ2ib_mnzQ1xn2iTAo) And I met Hurley and one of his sons HJ on a rainy day at a putting green in Michigan. We got to putt a little inside, heard about HJ’s golfing, and talked to his dad about our shared optimism for our country and the enormous opportunity we have to create a future for kids like HJ. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt0n_-PX9mL8yHKUav8QI_t1nqBov96CDdx3RRuXroiZEZ_yonP0FFXAef5KY2duyhMQXQqMTJ0r8vj4pnUkclJegqNRxi97-sZMUGuO4yTdL-yGLik4DWf9vMxGYRbkT0lqfJxffhjZb2__taqF1BQ492EbijqaNlbH6jPLKuRVEX5su6-C0cnNS-cAZXiPL5XI0OGfEqZq2Jb7VYFOfE4tzL5CockctE2EFZr2hWMLALq5xBxb19fLtp_8IZIv67KqaErd6sDmiqQzFrUzQCKeGC3v_VEJ8vOXMqJhVBnOYTRochByKJFX2nLeHSZx_S9pnNssEW9PgsdVtu2wnq0eM9Xd4TdL8DpgzXTTxeewXtOc1oO7BO1bM3Fi6Sa0z6YaR5KEnHfOIbnOm1SUU86/478/o3WF5yI-SP-A4IeVK4raSw/h3/h001.Uu_elzcrX70_EBjs5bCm-KDZLKg8YuRfVcUHC6qfKHs) While I am traveling across the nation, I need you to know I carry these stories with me. Every day, I wake up and I fight for families like Eric’s, for kids like Harry, for small businesses like the Cunicellis’, and for a brighter future filled with possibilities for kids like HJ. Since Day One, Kamala’s and my goal has been to give folks a little more breathing room. To make everyone’s lives a little freer. We’ve made real progress these last few years, but we know there is more work to do. We’re ready to finish the job. **But we’re counting on your support to win four more years in the White House. clean_body: You've stood with me time after time, and your generosity isn't taken lightly. I really mean that. | | | Listen, folks: This campaign isn’t about me. And it never will be. This campaign is about all of us. It’s about OUR future together. That’s why I feel so fortunate to be out on the campaign trail meeting supporters like you all across the country. I’ve met some really incredible people over the past year, and I wanted to share those experiences with you. In North Carolina, I sat down with Eric and his sons, Christian and Carter. Over burgers and fries, I got to hear all about Eric’s path to becoming a teacher and Carter and Christian’s basketball teams and extracurriculars. Eric shared with me how student loan relief has changed all of their lives for the better. It meant so much to me to hear that. I met Harry and his mom at one of my campaign rallies in Milwaukee. I’ve struggled with a stutter all my life. Harry told me he experiences the same thing. I told him he can’t let it get in the way of achieving his dreams. And I know he won’t. I’m so proud of him. Jill and I got to sit down with the Cunicelli family in Delaware County, Pennsylvania. Over pizza made by their family’s small business, we talked about the importance of family and gratitude. They were so generous, giving us a tour of their home and garden and a card their daughter, Stella, made with her classmates. I was honored to share a meal with them. And I met Hurley and one of his sons HJ on a rainy day at a putting green in Michigan. We got to putt a little inside, heard about HJ’s golfing, and talked to his dad about our shared optimism for our country and the enormous opportunity we have to create a future for kids like HJ. While I am traveling across the nation, I need you to know I carry these stories with me. Every day, I wake up and I fight for families like Eric’s, for kids like Harry, for small businesses like the Cunicellis’, and for a brighter future filled with possibilities for kids like HJ. Since Day One, Kamala’s and my goal has been to give folks a little more breathing room. To make everyone’s lives a little freer. We’ve made real progress these last few years, but we know there is more work to do. We’re ready to finish the job. But we’re counting on your support to win four more years in the White House. We cannot leave it up to chance, because we know exactly what Donald Trump and his MAGA Republican allies will do if they are elected again. | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Thanks for being with us. name: Josh Harder
subject: Is anyone else worried about this election?
body:
I know I am.
Hey Peter, it’s Josh.
We need to have a frank talk about the state of the presidential race. If the election were held today, Donald Trump would win. Based on every poll, that’s the truth.
Trump’s conviction has not changed the race in Democrats favor. Instead it has fired up the MAGA base so much so that it’s having ripple effects on down-ballot races, including ours.
We just learned the National Republican Congressional Committee raised over $1 million since he was found guilty, and the chairman said he’s “really excited” about my GOP opponent (aka that money is going straight to our opponent).
I’m not surprised I’m their #1 target this year, I’m just worried we cannot combat the onslaught of dark money coming our way.
**The truth is: this conviction has made everything tougher in my race. I’m going to need more resources.**
The first step we can take to fight back is reaching our end-of-quarter goal. We’re only two weeks away from our deadline and we’re not even halfway to our goal so I could really use your help!

subject: The earth is in a state of emergency
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=1)
---
Peter

The climate emergency is accelerating at a terrifying pace. All the signs of a deepening crisis are around us.

May 2024 marked 12 straight months of the highest temperatures on record, and we are paying for it in every part of life.****
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=2)
---
Just last month...

Tens of millions of school children were forced to stay home across Asia and North Africa because their school facilities don’t have adequate air conditioning to keep up with scorching temperatures.

Untold numbers of fish – a major source of income and critical food supply – died off in Asia due to rising temperatures in our oceans, rivers, and lakes.

Dead monkeys began falling out of trees in Mexico, collapsing from dehydration and extreme temperatures, threatening extinction of an already vulnerable species.

**Our planet is in the throes of a death scream. The climate emergency threatens our food supply, our housing, the delicate balance of our ecosystem – everything essential to life.

****But our leaders are not acting as if there is an emergency.

[I’m running for President to take the radical measures needed to ensure continued human survival. I need your help to keep us in the fight to deliver a ground shaking mandate for climate action in November.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=4)
---
The climate collapse most certainly disproportionately harms the Global South. Poor and working class communities have been stripped of their natural resources by imperial forces from the U.S. and Europe, deprived of the gifts that would otherwise help them survive.

But it would be the height of arrogance for Americans to believe that we cannot be similarly vulnerable to this crisis of our own making.

I’m writing to you today from Alabama, which is at the center of a weekend of record temperatures brought on by a “heat dome” parked over North America.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=5)
---
**The climate emergency doesn’t care how rich you are, how big your house is, or even how much political power you wield. It’s coming for all of us if we do not radically alter course.

** Ours is the ONLY campaign that will be on the ballot across the country this November that can credibly challenge empire, climate deniers, and climate delayers. Will you donate today to make sure every American has the opportunity to vote for people, planet, and peace?
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=6 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=6)
---
I’ve been fighting for climate justice my entire life because I know that change is mandatory – _and I also know it is possible._
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=7)
---
I’ve seen people rise up and mobilize in the face of a crisis time and again. I know that the solutions are within our grasp and that we have the collective capacity to save our planet and our people.

But small thinking and baby steps will never get us there. If we want bold changes we have to demand bold leaders.

As your president, I will declare a climate emergency on DAY ONE and immediately begin mobilizing the full force of the federal government to respond to the crisis _AS a crisis_.

You can read more about my plans for climate justice at [**jillstein2024.com/platform**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=Qj32F8ZTIcBOzthgR25-gF2J_V8cRlHgwGIBI_1lcLQ0Ce7w_K4rbPSVLguxOifF&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=8). As always, thank you for being in this fight with me.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_climate_update&n=9 "Support Jill Today!") [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86973693/479612714/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTk4NGI3MTctNDUyYi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dftIhC67ZJeTx9wtv2sK515fux2DnYXMjfnnJHiIv2k=&emci=8abeec3f-8c2a-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=5984b717-452b-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
**Joe Rogan is making sh*t up again, Peter: **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86973694/479612715/-593472309?refcode=20240615-EM-JoeRogan&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTk4NGI3MTctNDUyYi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dftIhC67ZJeTx9wtv2sK515fux2DnYXMjfnnJHiIv2k=)
_One of our favorite GIFs – Rogan making fun of COURIER’s mission to call out right-wing lies and conspiracy theories earlier this year._
This time, his target is President Biden’s health. We’ll tell you more in a sec, but before we do, **you should know that COURIER and our affiliated newsrooms in 11 battleground states are working around the clock to hold bad actors like Rogan accountable and deliver fact-based reporting to the communities that need it most. **
**[Can you pitch in $20 now to support our work?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86973695/479612716/-593472309?refcode=20240615-EM-JoeRogan&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTk4NGI3MTctNDUyYi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dftIhC67ZJeTx9wtv2sK515fux2DnYXMjfnnJHiIv2k=)**
Rogan has attacked President Biden’s age for a while now. On a recent episode of his podcast _The Joe Rogan Experience_ , Rogan used recent social media videos to up the ante, this time proposing a series of out-there conspiracies about Biden’s mental health without a shred of evidence. Those included:
* Biden is cognitively “gone,” and voters are being “gaslit” into voting for him again.
* When Biden makes public appearances, he’s “drugged up” on “vitamin infusions” and performance-enhancing drugs.
* A “mysterious cabal” is running the country because President Biden is too cognitively diminished to do it himself.

Here’s the thing, Peter – Rogan’s claims may be BS, but his influence isn’t.
He’s one of the most powerful influencers in the media right now. **His podcast is _still_ #1 on Spotify, and millions of voters hear and believe his conspiracies.**
**When Rogan dangerously speculates, without a shred of evidence, that a shadowy cabal is secretly running our country or that our President isn’t fit to do his duties, he’s hurting our democracy.**
At COURIER, our 11 battleground state newsrooms are fighting back with the truth. We work around the clock countering Rogan’s blatant falsehood and conspiracies by publishing factual news stories about the politics and issues that matter most to the communities we serve. We don’t traffic in lies and baseless speculation – we report out the truth and bring that truth to the social media feeds and email inboxes where voters are most likely to encounter misinformation.
[**The best part is that our innovative model is proven to increase voter participation. We can counter right-wing conspiracies and lies, but we can’t do it alone. Hunter Verdict Update

The Bidens are going down in the history books with the inaugural
felony conviction of a First Family member. Unlike former President
Trump, Hunter Biden received a fair trial. This guilty verdict is an
important first step toward accountability for Biden family
corruption.

The public would do well to remember that the Justice Department was
dragged, kicking and screaming into this prosecution of Hunter. Our
successful Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) litigation, exposing
federal special protection and the cover-up of Hunter Biden’s gun
scandal, shows how this case could have been brought years ago.

We’ve been at the forefront of pressuring the federal government to
come clean about its role in protecting Hunter Biden.

We sued the FBI for records regarding the gun owned by Hunter Biden
that reportedly was thrown in a trash can behind a Delaware grocery
store. In a

>
> Delaware police began investigating, concerned that the trash can

>
> But a curious thing happened at the time: Secret Service agents
