> The International Criminal Court at the Hague was back in the news
> recently with the announcement
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68702&L=32645&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9hcG5ld3MuY29tL2FydGljbGUvaWNjLWtoYW4tbmV0YW55YWh1LTA3MDk0MWQyMWNjZDFmMmI5NjExMDMyYjg4NTI3NTc1P3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=de4f5298548d47c2821302a589a7750792f46a4767eac80434e19f3759f95447]
> by its chief prosecutor that he would seek charges against Israeli
> Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Yoav Gallant
> for war crimes in Gaza, while simultaneously seeking charges against
> the leaders of Hamas for war crimes in Israel. This obscene act of
> moral equivalency
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68702&L=32646&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9hcG5ld3MuY29tL2FydGljbGUvaXNyYWVsLXBhbGVzdGluaWFucy1oYW1hcy1uZXRhbnlhaHUtc2lud2FyLWljYy0yZjU5YWI0ZTY0OTMwMWFmNmNhNTExNWNhNjk2NDBjNT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=2b044891dadfbe966e0c93f9e2c8a5dfd582ef5ce07d76403d38e4c9f67e00ac]
> tells you all you need to know about the ICC. It’s also a reminder
> that the most powerful prosecutor at work in the U.S. today, Special
> Counsel Jack Smith, has significant connections to the controversial
> court and another Hague tribunal.
>
> From 2008 to 2010, Smith was the Investigative Coordinator for the
> Office of the Prosecutor of the ICC—the same office that today is
> seeking arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant from a three-judge
> ICC panel. Founded in 2002 to pursue war crimes, the ICC has been
> viewed with skepticism by, among others, the U.S., Israel, Russia,
> China, and many African nations. In 2018, then-National Security
> Adviser John Bolton castigated the ICC for its failure to “deter
> and punish atrocity crimes” and its “threat to American
> sovereignty.” Last week, reacting to news of the Netanyahu arrest
> warrant, the House voted to sanction
>

> the ICC.
>
> ICC records
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68702&L=32648&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY2ZyLm9yZy9iYWNrZ3JvdW5kZXIvcm9sZS1pY2MjY2hhcHRlci10aXRsZS0wLTY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=83872a85eaecb926a3bcfa1d182aa4df913a2580dd590636b1d45935faaeb0f3]

> resulted in convictions.

> impressed. In 2010, Smith was plucked to head the Justice
> Department’s Public Integrity Section—a big promotion for a
> relatively untested young prosecutor. He served until 2015,
> supervising cases against former Virginia Governor Bob McDonnell,
> New York power broker Sheldon Silver, former Congressman Rick Renzi,
> and CIA operative Jeffery Sterling, among others.

> targeting of conservative groups. Smith testified that following a

> dialogue” with the FBI about opening investigations into

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68702&L=28702&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYWJjcy1pcnMtbWVzcy1qdXN0aWNlLWRlcHQtdGFpbnRlZC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=9ed8deea73b100efa959715399410668bbe1ab82033f763fc7deb8d74f0e300b].

clean_body: Hunter Biden Verdict Update! [INSIDE JW] Hunter Verdict Update [] The Bidens are going down in the history books with the inaugural felony conviction of a First Family member. Unlike former President Trump, Hunter Biden received a fair trial. This guilty verdict is an important first step toward accountability for Biden family corruption. The public would do well to remember that the Justice Department was dragged, kicking and screaming into this prosecution of Hunter. Our successful Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) litigation, exposing federal special protection and the cover-up of Hunter Biden’s gun scandal, shows how this case could have been brought years ago. HEARING HELD ON REOPENING LAWSUIT FOR PRESIDENT BIDEN’S SENATE RECORDS We were in the Superior Court of the State of Delaware this week for [ hearing [] on our petition to reopen our case for the release of Joe Biden’s Senate records kept at the University of Delaware. We have powerful evidence that the courts were misled about the Biden papers. Judicial Watch and the Daily Caller News Foundation asked the court to reopen the case in light of the findings of Special Counsel Robert Hur that contradict representations made under oath by representatives of the University of Delaware that no consideration was paid to Biden in connection with his gift of his Senate records. In July 2020, we filed the FOIA [ [] for the records, which are housed at the university’s library (Judicial Watch Inc. and The Daily Caller News Foundation v. DE Department of Justice and University of Delaware [] (No. N20A-07-001 CEB)). In July 2023 the Delaware Supreme Court [ [] with the university, denying the release of the records because the university stated to the courts that no tax dollars were used to manage them. In its petition to reopen the case, we argue: The [university’s affidavit] provides, in relevant part, that no consideration was paid to President Biden, “State funded or otherwise,” in connection with the Senatorial Papers. Micah Morrison, our chief investigative reporter, looks back [] in Investigative Bulletin. The International Criminal Court at the Hague was back in the news recently with the announcement [] by its chief prosecutor that he would seek charges against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Yoav Gallant for war crimes in Gaza, while simultaneously seeking charges against the leaders of Hamas for war crimes in Israel. This obscene act of moral equivalency [] tells you all you need to know about the ICC. It’s also a reminder that the most powerful prosecutor at work in the U.S. today, Special Counsel Jack Smith, has significant connections to the controversial court and another Hague tribunal. From 2008 to 2010, Smith was the Investigative Coordinator for the Office of the Prosecutor of the ICC—the same office that today is seeking arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant from a three-judge ICC panel. Founded in 2002 to pursue war crimes, the ICC has been viewed with skepticism by, among others, the U.S., Israel, Russia, China, and many African nations. In 2018, then-National Security Adviser John Bolton castigated the ICC for its failure to “deter and punish atrocity crimes” and its “threat to American sovereignty.” Last week, reacting to news of the Netanyahu arrest warrant, the House voted to sanction [] the ICC. By 2018, Smith was back at the Hague, this time as chief prosecutor for the Kosovo Specialist Chambers, another highly unusual judicial bod [ [.], formed to prosecute war crimes committed during the 1998-2000 Kosovo War. In 2022, Attorney General Merrick Garland brought Smith back to the U.S. to take over the investigation of former president Donald Trump. The rest is history. Two indictments of Trump quickly followed, along with rising public concern about Smith’s targeting of the frontrunner for the GOP presidential nomination. Judicial Watch has launched several investigations of Smith. We’re closely tracking developments at the Hague for what they might reveal about Smith’s prosecutorial conduct. We sued the Justice Department after it denied our FOIA request for the names of senior staff working for Smith; Justice responded by asking a federal court to keep those names secret []. We also sued for records and communications between Smith and state prosecutors in the separate Georgia investigation of Trump []. To date, in that case, the Justice Department has refused to confirm or deny the existence of records, claiming that to do so would interfere with law enforcement proceedings. We’ll continue pressing forward on all fronts. FINANCIAL IMPACT OF ILLEGALS ON PUBLIC EDUCATION SYSTEM IS ‘STAGGERING’ You can’t throw open the border to millions of people without consequences. One big cost for taxpayers and our children is in our schools, as our Corruption Chronicles blog shows []. Nearly half a million illegal immigrant minors have entered the United States through the porous Mexican border since President Joe Biden took office in 2021 and the financial impact on the nation’s public education system is staggering, according to information disclosed at a recent congressional hearing conducted to address the unprecedented crisis. “Educating illegal immigrant children requires substantial resources, altering the learning environment for all students,” said Florida Congressman Aaron Bean, who chairs a subcommittee on early childhood, elementary and secondary education for the House Education and Workforce Committee. “Overcrowded classrooms, the need for new facilities, and strained student-to-teacher ratios are just some of the challenges,” Bean added, offering that in just four states—California, New York, Texas, and Arizona—the cost of integrating illegal immigrant children into public schools reached nearly three-quarters of a billion dollars in one fiscal year. “If we assume that every illegal immigrant child encountered by border patrol enters the school system, the cost nationwide would be over two billion dollars annually,” said the lawmaker who conducted the recent hearing, titled “The Consequences of Biden’s Border Chaos for K-12 Schools [ Public schools are often the first to feel the impact of open border policies, according to testimony delivered at the hearing. That is partly because in 1982 the Supreme Court prohibited states from denying illegal immigrant children a public-school education. Since the ruling was issued, tens of millions of illegal aliens have entered the U.S. through the southern border with a substantial chunk enrolling in public schools across the country. Some come with family and others come without a guardian, which the government classifies as Unaccompanied Alien Children (UAC). Besides providing them with a free taxpayer-funded education, Uncle Sam also spends billions of dollars annually to house, medically treat and entertain UAC. Last year the Biden administration quietly doled out tens of millions of dollars [] for the long-term foster care of UAC to further assist migrants under the age of 17, including pregnant and parenting teens and those who are especially vulnerable or with other special needs. The impact on public education is just a snippet of the problem. Several examples were offered at the recent congressional hearing. In New York students were switched to online learning because nearly 2,000 illegal immigrants were sheltered in a school gymnasium. In Austin, Texas teachers had to conduct classes in hallways and conference rooms to accommodate over 400 newly enrolled illegal immigrant children. In Denver, Colorado an influx of over 40,000 illegal immigrants forced the state to spend an extra $24 million to cover the cost. In Chicago the mayor says the city’s resources are “tapped out,” and a local teacher reveals that over 40% of students qualify for English learner services and the numbers keep growing. In Massachusetts public schools have absorbed 2,000 new illegal immigrant students, forcing districts to find emergency housing with little notice. In New Mexico there have been incidents of adult-age illegal immigrants hiding in a middle school to avoid apprehension from Border Patrol, which led to the arrest of six illegal immigrants and prompted temporary lockdowns. Last year a congressional report that revealed the cost of illegal immigration is greater than the annual gross domestic product of 15 states [] [ that nearly four million illegal aliens attend public schools around that country and most receive special services for Limited English Proficiency (LEP) costing American taxpayers nearly $59 billion. New York City alone is spending around $440 million to educate about 11,500 illegal aliens who will likely remain in the system for years to come. Laughably, at last week’s K-12 congressional hearing only one witness—from the National Council of La Raza—testified that the nation’s education system actually benefits from the influx of illegal immigrants. Her name is Amalia Chamorro, education policy director at the leftist nonprofit. “In our nation’s schools, immigrant students are a significant asset in their classrooms,” Chamorro testified. “They are known for their resilience, grit, and problem-solving skills, which are critical for 21st -century learning. Derek — Instead
of working on a whole host of issues important to the American people,
MAGA Republicans in the House and the Senate hosted none other than Donald
Trump at the Capitol this week.

Or as I call it: Bring your felon to work day.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em.iyuBSf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240615_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=6712%2E5257348%2EfJlkGY ]Tweet from Adam Schiff: Bring your felon to work day, with a picture of
Trump in the Capitol

That’s right. Donald Trump returned to the Capitol to meet with the same
MAGA Republicans who enabled his assault on democracy and support his
extremist policies and authoritarian agenda.

Members of Congress presented Trump with a birthday cake. They welcomed
him warmly back to the Capitol complex — where he incited rioters to
attack them only three years earlier. I remember it vividly. I was with
those GOP members as they fled for their lives. Even Mitch McConnell, who
once stood up to Trump’s dangerous rhetoric, stood proudly alongside Trump
this week and called for unity.

It’s shameful behavior,
Derek. But at this point, it’s
no surprise.

Donald Trump is promising to be a dictator on day one if he’s elected and
prophesying a bloodbath if he’s not. Just like he incited an insurrection
on January 6th. The GOP knows exactly who he is, and they are welcoming
him back to the Capitol with open arms.

This says as much about Congressional Republicans as it says about Donald
Trump. They don’t care about anything except gaining power. They have
shown us who they really are over and over. There is nothing — absolutely
nothing — that would make them back away from Trump if it means another
chance to rule.

Not their oath. Not the Constitution. Only power matters to them. That’s
why we have to defeat them this November.

name: Matthew Davis, LCV
subject: TAKE ACTION: Tell officials to protect cleaner cars and trucks
body:
Our planet is counting on you, Peter.

| | | |
---
| |
## **Tell Officials to Protect Cleaner Cars & Trucks**
Vehicle emissions are the largest contributor to climate change in the United States and a major public health hazard. Slashing tailpipe emissions is a no-brainer for the health of our planet and our communities. But right now, Big Oil’s allies in Congress are working to overturn the Biden administration’s limits on pollution from new cars and trucks. We need YOUR help to fight back against polluters’ pressure campaigns. [**We need 5,000 LCV members to make their voices heard. Send a message to elected officials right now >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | | [ TAKE ACTION NOW ](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ywTd-w-)
---
| | | | Peter — earlier this year, the Biden administration finalized the strongest-ever pollution standards for new cars and trucks, in a huge win for our health and climate. Now, pro-polluter lawmakers are preparing to use the Congressional Review Act — a law allowing Congress to overturn environmental safeguards with a simple majority vote — to block those protections.
---
| | Before the EPA announced these strong pollution standards, we had to overcome an onslaught of misinformation and political pressure from Big Oil’s army of lobbyists in Washington, D.C. We have them back on their heels, _but they aren’t giving up yet_ — the fossil fuel industry will stop at nothing to sabotage the transition to clean and renewable energy and zero-emission vehicles.
---
| | **What happens next will come down to grassroots pressure from environmentalists like you.** That’s why we’re asking for your help to fight back against corporate polluters’ pressure campaigns and demand that officials take action for people and our planet.
---
| | [**Take action right now — it only takes a moment to tell your elected officialslawmakers to protect cleaner cars and trucks. Every action brings us closer to our 5,000 signature goal >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Ap9dcYWNW_)
---
| | Tailpipe emissions from cars and trucks are the number one source of climate-harming greenhouse gas emissions in the U.S. and cause thousands of deaths each year — and if Big Oil succeeds in overturning these protections, it’ll mean worsening climate change and more deadly pollution in our air.
---
| | Our calls to action have already overcome fierce opposition from Big Oil execs and extreme MAGA Republicans, proving — once again — just how powerful our movement is when we join together to demand a better future for people and our planet. **Now, we’re asking you to do it again — current and future generations are counting on us.**
---
| | [**Send a message to elected officials today: tell them to REJECT corporate polluters’ campaign against cleaner cars and trucks. It only takes a moment to bring us closer to our goal, so please don’t wait >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | Thank you for taking action, Peter.
---
| | Onward,
---
| | Matthew Davis
Vice President of Federal PolicyLeague of Conservation Voters

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=98c0c5ee37ff4828b79e86f8c327739e&_e=-65cnEiEj2P3_0b6bRUCpHsnrJ5cUazY5gytJvlLiBSqvP87934-ve4h7-gl0g_YGpanaMQC1rTqe7eKSoO8qA4XFLR51heP1DiUTqPU_n3ho6j2F5XMSKIBuQGf4nS2-FwewUl7cEPPAHmmHKLzu5joQbn0HDOXWcyhE0QETvb7hkV73zStmBVSd-Fzf9QSp6qtfoQH6-FL2yF-JXG1azVYoVD2nCVTzA8r7_DUfRN06fm4KEAVpmJv7m6Xg7vGDYA2UT8C653j0FRRCoc7wRsBx94ohFUrDok3HRaZSdv_m18eNu-XtLXg-SevvkfOneQx5CJWQPPY2wP6yST39W0mvZk3gWL5qFg5hNC_mCK2_hEaiEiBvlgcIBTQP1wT2CUAa1g3rLHy_6oTGdGNkfBZFUR2GMZrwBUTZRN607A%3D) **
As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=98c0c5ee37ff4828b79e86f8c327739e&_e=-65cnEiEj2P3_0b6bRUCpHsnrJ5cUazY5gytJvlLiBSqvP87934-ve4h7-gl0g_YGpanaMQC1rTqe7eKSoO8qA4XFLR51heP1DiUTqPU_n3ho6j2F5XMSKIBuQGf4nS2-FwewUl7cEPPAHmmHKLzu5joQbn0HDOXWcyhE0QETvb7hkV73zStmBVSd-Fzf9QSp6qtfoQH6-FL2yF-JXG1azVYoVD2nCVTzA8r7_DUfRN06fm4KEAVpmJv7m6Xg7vGLUzPmpoTnAKiCy37MoqC-ZNQnJscxWd-oOe0C4eIFvd01tuBwoOysPjaDmlDTxRa413VfSIVVKuvr1coIOdBHCfj-5RRlTYowVm6EeoMfpnkXeUm6Rg1prnq4xYrxLWdtl1zt9pGXzFWCEz85uGQ5ilxcv0c24t2M98TeZ1A8HA%3D)

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=98c0c5ee37ff4828b79e86f8c327739e&_e=-65cnEiEj2P3_0b6bRUCpHsnrJ5cUazY5gytJvlLiBSqvP87934-ve4h7-gl0g_YGpanaMQC1rTqe7eKSoO8qA4XFLR51heP1DiUTqPU_n3ho6j2F5XMSKIBuQGf4nS2-FwewUl7cEPPAHmmHKLzu5joQbn0HDOXWcyhE0QETvb7hkV73zStmBVSd-Fzf9QSp6qtfoQH6-FL2yF-JXG1azVYoVD2nCVTzA8r7_DUfRN06fm4KEAVpmJv7m6Xg7vGrN6TqzpDInRMoQxJEmNRTOGJBty7AD1zHprLz1AFhDjzAYRCfjw2ZtZCQIFq16U12yeZGgLSRaUUyAz3ApLP43gUKhOv0c9OsWM8R1kdtNU-jBw0EZTKZTZRuJyXIrGyG8cDmC0Cg67NOdvFpHYpX_WKPI902W_oIxzd7X5TiVE%3D)

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

10 EMILYs List-endorsed candidates will now advance to the general election for the state legislature, and New Mexico voters soundly rejected three different anti-choice candidates, along with one accused of serial sexual predation. Here's what we were up against, and how a few of these incredible women can make history in November:
* Indigenous activist **Angel Charley** defeated former state Sen. Clemente Sanchez in New Mexico's 30th state Senate District, and will become the first woman to ever represent this district if she wins in November.

* Navajo attorney **Michelle Paulene Abeyeta** defeated state Rep. Harry Garcia in New Mexico's 69th state House District, and would become the first woman and the first Indigenous person to represent this majority Native American district.

* STEM advocate **Anita Gonzales** defeated state Rep. Ambrose Castellano in New Mexico's 70th state House District, and would be the first woman and woman of color to represent this district _since 1970_.

* In New Mexico's 15th state Senate District, policy analyst and finance consultant **Heather Berghmans** defeated Rep. Daniel Ivey-Soto, a 10-year veteran of the New Mexico state Legislature accused by multiple women of sexual harassment and other abuse.

Our opponents in these primaries all sided with radical, anti-choice extremist Republicans to try to strip New Mexicans of reproductive freedom, and **New Mexicans made it clear at the primary polls last week: Voters across the state want strong, pro-choice leadership fighting for their rights.**

I take a long drive to practice reproductive health care. Come with me.
| Team,

**We’ve just released our campaign launch video –** [and I want you to be the first to see it.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70276?t=6&akid=15126%2E878179%2EfWiAuu) [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70276?t=7&akid=15126%2E878179%2EfWiAuu) Multiple times a month, I take a long drive to Minnesota, where I practice reproductive health care and care for patients.

I do this because of anti-abortion restrictions that took effect in Wisconsin after the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade._

Those restrictions severely impacted my ability to care for patients, but I didn’t just sit back and allow politicians to dictate how I provide care. I fought back, and in Wisconsin, we won: My name is on the judgment that overturned Wisconsin’s 1849 abortion ban.

Now, I’m running for Congress because I’m sick of watching politicians play games with the needs of my patients and my community. [Please, take a moment to watch my video – and then chip in $10 between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project to my campaign to help us share it with the world.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70276?t=8&akid=15126%2E878179%2EfWiAuu) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Kristin Lyerly and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70277?t=9&akid=15126%2E878179%2EfWiAuu)

Friend, I have a major campaign update for you.

My far-Left opponent Ruben Gallego was just caught at a swanky Los Angeles fundraiser, rubbing elbows with and cashing checks from a whos who of liberal MegaDonors.

Why does this matter? Because Ruben is showing us who he is. He'll take those checks and run ads saying he's a "moderate", but at his heart, he's an out of touch coastal elite trying to fool hardworking Arizonans.

**[Chip in to help me fight back](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=520b94cef98e4dcfbd1365f60b9947ba&_e=qPNblJU8D5KZf2hb7ahYGiZxm5JwU6v9JSMQzqTf6iWK2cd-BK18R_asj8p2cENMYLNXAfsCsrEVpXs8te8Nq--l5FsAqOUTpe84IaZ4F7mK0GUZJ943wQiTXRoLozQiLSzhEdHiwasznIx-O_KeRbBeUR_zx1SuRfG8DFc0bsNG0OQMtEOE1ikCI_DBMbYB6A5SpHAM3FG4F0-zoeuMB471vHt6pLnIaZnQ_KYhfQK6pucNat_Az9dFXjqLX6pQTNnGTncK1v0HBqzLksGx4mxZs1v9ZzzPT6uRZm7J3hSDxd-cUC5dP4572eHOWJ-69Lt5U3PXWnuhFZvtCZ7T_D7VBBlk-Nkn4UMUqOYWPgQdvHwA_Xuwwv5Gv2VQ37MwLLED6b51bJkvDm45juiZLA%3D%3D).**

The truth about Ruben Gallego is clear. He's put liberal millionaires ahead of the American people. That's why he votes with Joe Biden nearly 100% of the time, why he takes his marching orders from George Soros, and why he's spending his weekends fundraising with Beverly Hills big shots, not campaigning in Arizona.

Ruben isn't running to represent Arizona. He's running to represent his liberal mega-donors. He's already spending millions of dollars against me, and thanks to his Hollywood friends, you can bet the attacks will keep on coming.

name: Laura Ciscomani
subject: Juan's driving force
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CISCOMANI FOR CONGRESS
body:
|
---
| | Hi friends, As you know, Juan has always been involved in every area of our kiddos’ lives — from classroom volunteer to field trip chaperone, to flag football coach. When we embarked on this journey, he promised the kids that would not change. **There are a lot of things to be proud of when it comes to my husband, but I am most grateful for how intentional he has been during this new season of life.** For example, he has taken each one of our six kids to DC for a week, one by one. The kids call it their “one-on-one trip”. I’ll often overhear them talking to each other about something that happened during _their_ one-on-one week.
[](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=b73ab74c71&e=659fba240e)
---
| It's not a stretch to say that being a dad to our six kids is the driving force behind Juan’s results-oriented approach to legislating. **It’s all about time.** He is sacrificing time with our family to serve the people of district six and our country. In my husband’s mind, this sacrifice _must_ render maximum impact because what he is giving up is so precious to him. Through their one-on-one trips, each of our kids has witnessed first-hand the service their dad gives to his constituents, and they genuinely admire him for it. I am a big believer in the adage, “more is caught than taught.” For this reason, I am certain our kids have “caught” the importance of servant leadership through their dad’s example. **A hard reality is that as a member of Congress, Juan must run every two years. We live in a tough, competitive district and the Democrats WANT this seat to regain the majority in the House.** It's one of just 18 swing districts in the country. Already, over $2.0 million has been spent on negative and dishonest attack ads about my husband. Through it all, Juan remains optimistic and busy doing his best for the people of district six. That’s why I am reaching out to ask for your help. **Would you be willing to help support Juan’s end of quarter push for the new 2024 cycle, which ends June 30th? **

All eyes will be watching to see what Juan can raise when the numbers become public in July. Your donation will send a message that our district is not up for grabs. **_Anything will help --- $25, $50, $100!!_**

**[DONATE HERE](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=403d609041&e=659fba240e)**
Our family thanks you for your support!
With gratitude,
Laura Ciscomani [](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=f470c4330f&e=659fba240e)

body:
We recently celebrated Dr. Cornel West’s birthday and launched a special campaign inviting supporters to donate in his honor.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dr_west_birthday?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dcw_birthday_no_open&n=1)

---
Dear Peter, We recently celebrated Dr. Cornel West’s birthday and launched a special campaign inviting supporters to donate in his honor. If you missed our previous email, we wanted to make sure you know how important this initiative is. **Why This Matters:** Dr. West has dedicated his life to fighting for justice and equality. Your support can help us continue this critical work and bring about real change. **Give the Gift of a Cup of Coffee:** We’re asking supporters to donate the equivalent of a cup of coffee each week for the rest of the month. Your contribution can make a significant impact.

---
**Share the Love:** Once you’ve made your donation, we encourage you to share this request with a new friend each week. This is a great opportunity to talk about the impact Dr. West has had on your life and invite others to support our cause. **About Dr. Cornel West:** Dr. Cornel West has dedicated his life to fighting for the marginalized and voiceless, making profound contributions to academia, civil rights, social justice, and music. From his early days at Harvard and Princeton to his current role in this historic presidential campaign, Dr. West has consistently championed the values of truth and love. His work as a philosopher, theologian, activist, and musician has inspired millions around the world.
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dr_west_birthday?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dcw_birthday_no_open&n=5)
---
**Activism Academia:** Dr. West's resignation from Harvard in 2021 highlighted his protest against institutional injustices, condemning "narcissistic academic professionalism" and anti-Palestinian prejudices, standing firm on his principles of integrity and courage. **Activism****Publication:** His landmark book, "Race Matters," published on the anniversary of the Los Angeles riots and Billie Holiday’s birthday, addresses enduring racial issues and inspires action, reinforcing his role as a powerful voice in the fight against racial inequality. **Activism****Music:** In "Never Forget: A Journey of Revelations" (2007), Dr. West uses music to explore interconnected oppressions, collaborating with artists like Talib Kweli and Jill Scott to amplify messages of resistance and justice.
---

---
---
Thank you for your generosity and for being part of this movement. Let’s make Dr. West’s year one of progress and change. **In eternal love and solidarity,**
The West-Abdullah 2024 Campaign Team

body:

__
Stop the Biden Administration's radical abortion agenda! | | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. | |
Dear Fellow American,

It's Sarah Huckabee Sanders, Governor of Arkansas.

You and I both know that every life is a precious gift. Yet, the Biden Administration continues to threaten the innocent and the voiceless under the guise of reproductive rights.

Every day, they press ahead with policies that expand access to dangerous abortion drugs and allow abortion-on-demand, resulting in countless, unthinkable losses of innocent life. The danger to future generations, the heartbreaking impact on families, and the erosion of our most fundamental values as Americans are at stake.

But we don't have to accept this reality. There is a solution, and you are a key part of it.

I am proud to join forces with SBA Pro-Life America, the most principled and effective organization fighting to end abortion in our country. By advocating for legislation that serves women and saves babies, SBA Pro-Life America stands at the forefront of this battle for life.

**But our effectiveness relies on dedicated individuals like YOU. YOUR voice matters. YOUR actions matter.**

That's why I'm personally inviting you to join us by signing the Stand For Life Pledge. This is a powerful way for us to demonstrate that, together, we form a strong, nationwide coalition poised to protect life, challenge policies that devalue it, and promote a culture that cherishes the value of every human life.

As a pro-life American, would you step forward today and sign our Pledge for Life? You can do so at the link below:

[https://action.sbaprolife.org/sarah-huckabee-sanders](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=83cec746737446f39b2cfb19290975fe&_e=PJX1SPzWepEezKvZTUyld5EdExqZPPfiDfxj2IDbIWiC_yHWWyPs1TeWALu6C2EkZrNYqVzCzoQrT0EMrmH-WO8_GjSwZplhBm4tkTxJCDWM56TVVC3jML8Wwp_Bs9XafzR_8nQRK2MYGCzaPKGkHd5EPi3YrzYXXfSz1XJ4f63FGM51AMn1K45E9H-TLqGdU_-TGXRrniotNE8qwFtgoD1CKvYihFuVdb0sveJUSshXStj3wl8WJQ1I6r_oxB7VLS88hSt-PYqND9ymc0B8p90pgkQxoILtGsDd7i3Lnf6k5akBYXXSJnFkIlx0i-YcxhG6oaro-qXRImWHTYzLuYWS65jnc8cGdq09BVTb-8BxNlZd0TvqkUWU-vNrC0ag)

Together, we can protect the future and build a pro-life America. Thank you for standing with us and for acting on your beliefs - because it's in these actions that change truly begins.

God bless you,

Sarah Huckabee Sanders
Governor of Arkansas

This year’s Congressional Baseball Game was another one for the books, complete with crazy Left-wing protesters storming the field to hoot and holler about [climate change](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=9376fcc2135f4646ae4fd4c58e3256d3&_e=8PRRAD2MpY07_8UCFkSfK9SR7LXpZ7rZwSgPUsHeCsZQucazopzVDI-wqxoFhG3tLNYYNkaf5MwdNUNhJtkinNr37goVdjWDCxTdiPsouRyE048juXF1k_pNfabXP6jhH3ab4Y7IPNu6G57nhk1u6mW0Vb36ycoGq2RnBGxwji0IG9dq-OPqA4fnkHsNqseffDfhLZvboJdMuz43upuue6NDbAjBolsm2GXgADW5pzQLm4DXQlshnaYs3Y7X--n-RhIp84i9tjSmOqqBTw7R09QaFUYLt4yH9zgulI8UrEEnPGPDDTkM7tDf6rv7JB0p). Their antics may have been loud, but they didn’t rattle our cages. Despite the raucous nonsense, Republicans were laser focused. The Democrats managed to pull ahead in the second inning for a hot second, but we came roaring back quickly with [nine runs](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=9376fcc2135f4646ae4fd4c58e3256d3&_e=8PRRAD2MpY07_8UCFkSfKxR72pOkt3Fzb6aE8BLUwm5qVJ-fWWalxizE2xMEceD1eMi5OmOAfcuRD8SvMghVV7rM0N4G53ZjMdmGI1JnSDu6ai3mhhtOJMKvqKjQzP9oUjCj4omhRRee6IYS8_lcGLv66J-5g79rmjilNvHej6SqvQaUxMS9zPMwD6p8LOzSIWKM7ycf2X2RBaQ1Xim2ZRn3z7Z4qcfyWqDeJXOkZzWfK9AVeBfOJfwnRNF9X4GN7gIH8qv8Hj7C6yAeaAuhhglW_utVz1nujEHMNTJJnm8%3D) across the third and fourth innings, and the rest was just gravy. We brought home a W for the fourth year in a row with a final score of 31-11. This event is something I look forward to every year—and not just because it gives Republicans a chance for a little camaraderie as we smoke Democrats on the diamond. The game also allows us all to reach across the aisle for a good cause. We knocked it out of the park this year by raising an impressive [$2.2 million](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=9376fcc2135f4646ae4fd4c58e3256d3&_e=8PRRAD2MpY07_8UCFkSfKxopD7n6j4bPzEeeKIhiooqOY-7F2VHuwyy7OQo9jkiKSiwp8E4MxQ-TDDV3uOXbdnbpWYNuC5i89Dqv_56bSsSoGBw-M7Qk-TJCpYQ_WwISFs2kJlTHalPRkkrG9VlBqWZKEzQEvkvDFO-c6mI_9jKaqKpHcWQ286QcdsZqyDPE28_s7pun3JBPnkWDkqObyN3ei55zlZsuxA4nt9DVf2I1J0pRjkf7gdcxq8LwOXvJoQ1tNeZj_RfqogEApJIDt_AV6odyeQt9NyZBEiAIJzS0ghaOYg8Xhyzv3okmOw-M3jUUtbohGIlLueHVDCH5_2IVVedT1b-e6MPq10abmVY%3D) for local charities. body:
[1]Powered By People

At least this much is true: Because of the crimes he chose to commit and
the court trial where the evidence of his crimes was presented (and
contested by the most aggressive defense money can buy), Donald Trump was
convicted by twelve ordinary Americans who, despite the pressure and the
stakes, followed the facts and decided that no one is above the law.

The former president of the United States is now a felon.

Trump has responded, predictably, by lying about all of it, feeding his
followers and anyone else he is able to reach with falsehood laid atop
falsehood. His acolytes – Republican senators, congressmen and governors –
repeat his lies and sow distrust and confusion among their own followers.

Then, Governor Abbott tweeted:

The message: This verdict is illegitimate. And Biden did it.

It would be bad enough if this were an isolated incident. But here’s the
pattern among Republican leaders like Abbott, marching in ever tighter
lockstep with Trump:

* Deny the results of the 2020 presidential election and refuse to
acknowledge that Joe Biden is the legitimate president of the United
States.

* Publicly refuse to accept the results of the 2024 presidential
election if Donald Trump doesn’t win.

* Signal that political terror is OK (Trump promised to pardon those
convicted for violence on January 6th and Abbott actually pardoned a
white nationalist who killed a BLM protestor)

And now,

* Reject Trump’s 34 felony convictions as the product of a sham trial
and undermine faith in the judiciary.

Not only is this comprehensive political fraud threatening the rule of
law, our democracy and our system of justice; it is setting a new and
incredibly dangerous precedent for our country.

Because, if Trump and his court of MAGA lords are able to successfully
hold that a lost election or an unfavorable jury trial is illegitimate,
who that follows them as a candidate or office holder will refuse to do
the same? In fact, it is quickly becoming the new normal for the
Republican party.

And when it becomes normal and accepted for one party, what is the other
party going to do?

In other words, if Republicans deny election losses and refuse to
acknowledge lawful winners if those winners are Democrats; if they
threaten voters with political violence; if they question the legitimacy
of the courts and jury trials – if they are able to successfully compete
outside the rules... are Democrats suckers for staying within them?

How long will Democrats resist this lawlessness once the disadvantage
imposed by following the rules compromises their political viability? Why
wouldn’t they adopt the same tactics, claiming, perhaps truthfully, that
it is the only way they can compete?

That is why it is so critical that we defeat the forces of mendacity and
violence in our country, before they can fully and, perhaps irrevocably,
take hold.

For Powered by People, that starts in Texas where our volunteers are
committing their time and resources to reach, register and turn out the
hundreds of thousands of eligible unregistered Democrats across this
state.

They are the key to restoring democracy, rule of law and the truth in
Texas.

Thank you for your help,

Beto

body:
I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. It isn’t much, but...
Friend, I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift.
And I know we send a lot of emails already, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.
The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point.
But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity, or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump.
And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really.
**She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip. **
One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.
If we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, hold on to the Senate, and defeat Donald Trump, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.
So, please:

When my dad was five years old, he immigrated from Mexico to Texas. He picked cotton and tomatoes in the fields of the Rio Grande Valley, all the while dreaming that one day he would work his way out of poverty and make it to the middle class.
My parents taught me the value of hard work. And I grew up believing that if we worked hard anything was possible.
But when I got to college, I realized my parents didn’t have the money to pay for my tuition and their groceries. So I worked all kinds of odd jobs to put myself through school. It took seven years, but I finished my degree and became the first person in my family to graduate from college.
That got me thinking: How could it be this difficult, when we did everything right? And I know that’s a question on the minds of so many families today across Oregon and our nation.
**I ran for Congress because I believe Oregon deserves leaders who will work hard every day to make life better for all of us. I’ve worked hard to deliver progress, and I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together so far. But if we’re going to make the kind of change the American people deserve, we need to win this battleground seat and flip the House blue. It’s as simple as that.**
If we’re going to reinstate abortion rights in this nation, we need to win this race.
If we’re going to stop another MAGA-fueled attempt to overturn the results of the next election, we need to win this race.
If we’re going to make more progress protecting our environment for future generations, we need to win this race.
If we’re going to build an economy that’s fairer for working families — with affordable health care, a livable minimum wage, and paid family leave no matter what state you live in — we need to win this race.

clean_body: = I’m going to be candid with you: this is a fundraising email. Our Mid-June deadline is only hours away, and we need some more help to reach it. Right now, in our campaign office, we’re celebrating every ping ActBlue makes when a donation comes in. They’re coming at a steady trickle, but we need them pinging off the hook. = | | = When my dad was five years old, he immigrated from Mexico to Texas. He picked cotton and tomatoes in the fields of the Rio Grande Valley, all the while dreaming that one day he would work his way out of poverty and make it to the middle class. My parents taught me the value of hard work. And I grew up believing that if we worked hard anything was possible. But when I got to college, I realized my parents didn’t have the money to pay for my tuition and their groceries. So I worked all kinds of odd jobs to put myself through school. It took seven years, but I finished my degree and became the first person in my family to graduate from college. That got me thinking: How could it be this difficult, when we did everything right? And I know that’s a question on the minds of so many families today across Oregon and our nation. I ran for Congress because I believe Oregon deserves leaders who will work hard every day to make life better for all of us. I’ve worked hard to deliver progress, and I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together so far. But if we’re going to make the kind of change the American people deserve, we need to win this battleground seat and flip the House blue. It’s as simple as that. If we’re going to reinstate abortion rights in this nation, we need to win this race. If we’re going to stop another MAGA-fueled attempt to overturn the results of the next election, we need to win this race. If we’re going to make more progress protecting our environment for future generations, we need to win this race. | | Dear Fellow Patriot, If you opened this letter because you remember my playing days with the Dodgers and the Padres, thank you. Having you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees... ...well, as they say, "Those were the days." But this email - isn't about baseball in fact, it's an email I never thought I'd be writing to you. **[Today, I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a seat in the United States Senate.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=a72c592e231c46ddb6b315016a303f6c&_e=74Y7W60L-oR-M2WcOfB0Zkf7rQSNPc2PUMnQYXo4GRAtsET8mAxP7EmHeB2EdSH5KWIWmGGFyg7OmWPMY4FS_1LyyWfwOCpag9dIt14yDf-nzXCXYDmqnEj1p9VKVYy0NHE21H41PkZpb1quYaEIeopuzwnJrFwEYgAEklYA-jTEYjYFt06kd7NvmuyuMk6RWAPZGClVn5VhEkrpJ15Tqe-cYHRqOmi0SW1bxweyTtjtUS2_J-9dDEKlPfL4HxV2pwVGbd8XuQ_5So7016q7IdH-x7ZIapn4G5JzUwss1440YGqpAiyFzYHRFGy8GQBS6xRJdYcqlnmCLZQGcbBhgiCeny-FMLTe_RDVg1tuB9213hIs3N8mN7K4nBcK7kOmZgh4Xpl3t1LaY7cPt8nWnA%3D%3D)** Today, I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come. Because when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s weren't as good as we tend to first remember. Baseball was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy after another. I'm running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: ► Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. **_Remember?_** ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. _**Remember?**_ ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. _**Remember?**_ Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again." There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And I wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best days are behind us." But listen, here's something I also want you to remember... **_We_ _Republicans_ pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan. ** **We put classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.** **And America became a shining city upon a hill once more.** **_We_ _can_ _do_ _that_ _again._** **It starts by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.** **But there's no way I can pull it off without you.** [**That's why I'm asking you to rush back your _Garvey for Senate_ contribution of $35 or more right away. **](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=a72c592e231c46ddb6b315016a303f6c&_e=74Y7W60L-oR-M2WcOfB0Zkf7rQSNPc2PUMnQYXo4GRAtsET8mAxP7EmHeB2EdSH5KWIWmGGFyg7OmWPMY4FS_1LyyWfwOCpag9dIt14yDf-nzXCXYDmqnEj1p9VKVYy0NHE21H41PkZpb1quYaEIeopuzwnJrFwEYgAEklYA-jTEYjYFt06kd7NvmuyuMk6RWAPZGClVn5VhEkrpJ15Tqe-cYHRqOmi0SW1bxweyTtjtUS2_J-9dDEKlPfL4HxV2wcbOQGhwBTv-Wpr_cJnJ79u091PvFyWsEMeDrF2EBQzXVaU2-By7wdMEIbOaaCaHbPulbydZ0hvDAatxcTcfZD10wStM7_OK3Pn7k7ylMAlz2JY1MP5RZ1vtwmqTQKBJ3UCqwRMQwK9I9GFekba1wA%3D%3D) I'm sorry for the urgency but Election Day is just six months away... And in that time, we need to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff who has ActBlue allies and a war chest he's assembled during his two decades in Washington, D.C. That may seem daunting, but I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. Second... you know I'm not a career politician. But I do have the _one_ _thing_ a Republican needs to get elected in California... ...name recognition. I'm no Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to President Reagan. But California voters know me. And Adam Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race. As I'm writing you this letter, there are just a few percentage points separating us. We've got a shot -- a very real shot -- in the general election. But we only have six months. And the giant Democrat political machine is going to use every second of that time trying to bury me and our common sense message. [**When you rush your _Garvey for Senate_ campaign contribution of $35 or more... **](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=a72c592e231c46ddb6b315016a303f6c&_e=74Y7W60L-oR-M2WcOfB0Zkf7rQSNPc2PUMnQYXo4GRAtsET8mAxP7EmHeB2EdSH5KWIWmGGFyg7OmWPMY4FS_1LyyWfwOCpag9dIt14yDf-nzXCXYDmqnEj1p9VKVYy0NHE21H41PkZpb1quYaEIeopuzwnJrFwEYgAEklYA-jTEYjYFt06kd7NvmuyuMk6RWAPZGClVn5VhEkrpJ15Tqe-cYHRqOmi0SW1bxweyTtjtUS2_J-9dDEKlPfL4HxV2aO8-a8jzgjbR3wlcOuIA6pEUyRjZuu09DoWi5GD3KcMSIUTes3Am4PhejfiQUBdrWT8NIDPrn4BtN3h4roCXHrEHT9iMhkXPtr738zQF67ylxW3XstZ55UT3PLXAyJCHIfx3K1oE3qFIiaE3p_YlhA%3D%3D) ...you're helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers, EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message: _You don't have to accept failed Democrat policies that make _all of us_ less safe, less prosperous, and less free. _ This race is the toughest in the nation. But they say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball. And you know I've done that plenty of times. Now I'm ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -- win in California as a common sense Republican. But I can't do it without you. When we win here... when we rip this seat out of the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the _nationwide_ Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. It all depends on the choice you make in the next 48 hours. You can do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can step up to the plate with me and take a swing for the thrill of victory. Please join me. Because when we win in California, we're winning for all of America.

clean_body: | | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot, If you opened this letter because you remember my playing days with the Dodgers and the Padres, thank you. Having you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees... ...well, as they say, "Those were the days." But this email - isn't about baseball in fact, it's an email I never thought I'd be writing to you. Today, I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come. Because when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s weren't as good as we tend to first remember. Baseball was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy after another. I'm running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: ► Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember? ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember? ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember? Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again." There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And I wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best days are behind us." But listen, here's something I also want you to remember... We Republicans pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan. We put classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did. And America became a shining city upon a hill once more. We can do that again. It starts by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California. But there's no way I can pull it off without you. I'm sorry for the urgency but Election Day is just six months away... And in that time, we need to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff who has ActBlue allies and a war chest he's assembled during his two decades in Washington, D.C. That may seem daunting, but I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. Second... you know I'm not a career politician. But I do have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in California... ...name recognition. I'm no Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to President Reagan. But California voters know me. And Adam Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race. As I'm writing you this letter, there are just a few percentage points separating us. We've got a shot -- a very real shot -- in the general election. But we only have six months. And the giant Democrat political machine is going to use every second of that time trying to bury me and our common sense message. ...you're helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers, EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message: You don't have to accept failed Democrat policies that make all of us less safe, less prosperous, and less free. This race is the toughest in the nation. But they say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball. And you know I've done that plenty of times. Now I'm ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -- win in California as a common sense Republican. But I can't do it without you. When we win here... when we rip this seat out of the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. It all depends on the choice you make in the next 48 hours. You can do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can step up to the plate with me and take a swing for the thrill of victory. Please join me. Because when we win in California, we're winning for all of America. | | Thank you and God Bless, | | Steve Garvey #6 | | | P.S. It's the bottom of the 9th and Republicans desperately need a homerun. We simply can't let another election slip through our fingers while Democrats go on destroying our country. With your help, I know we can beat Adam Schiff in California and start the Republican Comeback Rally America needs. Thank you! \--Steve | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE PO Box 532389 Los Angeles, CA 90053-2389 |

body:
We have till November to fight back against MAGA extremists, will you join the effort? | |
---
Hi Derek, it’s Elizabeth Warren. Yes, 2024 is about keeping Trump out of the White House. That is a top priority. But it’s also about making sure Democrats can defeat Republicans _everywhere_. It’s about the policies we’re fighting for, and the people who those policies benefit. Today marks 12 years since President Obama signed the executive order granting temporary protection to millions of young immigrants.

| Peter,

I was born and raised in Southern California to immigrant parents from Mexico, the sixth of seven children. My father worked as an industrial mechanic, and my mother was an elementary school teacher who decided to further her education by attending school at night. They made sure all seven of their children went on to become college graduates.

Millions of people across the country have stories like mine. That’s why I deeply understand the importance of **DACA (Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals)** and what it has done for thousands of families across the U.S.

**Today marks 12 years since President Obama signed the executive order granting temporary protection to millions of young immigrants. But this is only temporary. The urgency of providing a pathway to citizenship that is efficient and possible cannot be understated.**

Today, let’s recognize Dreamers' resilience, courage, and contributions across the country. We must reaffirm our commitment to fighting for comprehensive immigration reform that protects their rights and provides them with a pathway to citizenship.

¡Ánimo!

Linda

This is actually crazy, Peter.

A former chief justice of the Missouri Supreme Court just said Missouri law puts IVF at risk. He said we need new legislation from Congress to protect it.

**But Josh Hawley voted against the Right to IVF Act anyway.**
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86981645/479639730/-1445316835?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240615_1_3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkyYjA4YTY0LTY3MmItZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=-ur3iNUpDZvgKTk7L1kvGuJIf82UKLggOdy7BVha_gU=)
**This is the second time Hawley has refused to support real efforts to protect IVF in the Senate, and he says it’s all because it’s part of an “abortion agenda”.**

You and I both know that IVF isn’t abortion, and neither is birth control. **But Hawley isn’t like you and me. He is on a career-long crusade against reproductive freedom.**

And don’t forget: _Hawley pioneered the legal arguments that led to closures of IVF clinics in Alabama, and that now threaten IVF access across the country._

Josh Hawley’s extremism is putting the future of Missouri families in jeopardy.

**I’m running to replace Hawley in the U.S. Senate because I want everyday Missourians to have the power to decide how to build their families.**

In addition to protecting IVF, I want to codify Roe v. Wade, end Missouri’s total abortion ban, and put a stop to the creepy Big Brother attacks on reproductive rights by control-obsessed politicians like Hawley once and for all.

**With so much on the line, none of us can afford another six years of Josh Hawley’s crusade against reproductive freedom.** But if we’re able to reach voters with this message early and often, I know we can flip this seat and take back power for working people this November. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/26872?t=30&amount=25&akid=1856%2E52803%2ENiVtSs) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/26872?t=31&amount=25&akid=1856%2E52803%2ENiVtSs) It was an honor joining the congregation at First Baptist Church of District Heights for Sunday Service.
